Refactor background analysis architecture for multi-document analysis (#245)

* WIP: background analysis reuse

* Establish the source boundary and event pump

Open and closed files share one source record. The consumer alternates client messages with ordered disk observations. Buffer text stays in SafeDoc; a closed file is read only when a refresh asks, and close does not read disk. Folder changes stay index policy.

* Unify open-document analysis and acceptance

* Separate document source identity from backend location

* Analyze virtual buffers with an isolated source lifecycle

* Keep virtual analysis and feature results isolated from workspace state

* Add startup exclusions for document schemes and exact URIs

* Verify virtual document coexistence and protocol compatibility

* Let ordinary Check Syntax failures return empty results

* Fix deadline handling on Racket 8.0 and earlier

* Connect definition to the unified source and analysis model

* Reuse shared background analysis for imported hover

* Evaluate background analysis reuse through real LSP transport

* Do not add source snippet in hover handler when documentation section exists

* Use parallel threads for expansion workers

* Separate available analysis from refresh completion

* Retain completed file analysis across buffer lifetimes

* Serve retained target facts while shared analysis refreshes

* Verify retained analysis lifecycle and Typed Racket refresh

* Fix CI tests on some Racket versions

* Fix CI tests on some Racket versions

* Fix CI tests on some Racket versions attempt 3

* Simplify code and remove uri ignore mechanism

* Simplify workspace/source-store

* Refactor and simplify source controller

* Improve analysis.rkt and analysis-query.rkt

* Improve multi-document query compose logic

* Remove legacy goto-definition logic

* Improve compose/target.rkt

* Guess best effort relative load directory for virtual document in check-syntax

* Reduce shared indentation in hover Source sections

* Remove cross-file definition query restriction

* Improve comments and documentations

* Fix scribble documentation

* Use ContentModified error code when possible

* Remove some useless tests

* Improve reuse in tests code and remove some useless tests

* Add 60 second timeout to each test file in CI

* Use ordinary threads for expand, instead of parallel threads

* Reduce file read and query timeout

* Apply path and URI invariant

1. All incoming URIs can include non-normalized paths.
2. All paths in the project use complete and normalized paths. When a URI is needed at protocol boundary, use the URI the client passed. If it's not passed by the client, generate one from normalized paths.
3. Paths identify file sources. Equal normalized paths identify the same files.
4. Virtual sources (non `file://` URIs) use their entire URI as identity. All other places use path.

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Original URI address plus a stable identity. File URI aliases share an
+;; identity when their decoded paths normalize to the same complete path.
+;; This module converts between them and never holds text or lifetime.
+;; Tables key on `source-id`; `source-file-path` is absent for virtual
+;; sources.
+(require racket/contract
+         "path-util.rkt")
+
+(provide Source?
+         Source-Id?
+         (contract-out
+           [uri->source (-> string? Source?)]
+           [path->source (-> path? Source?)]
+           [file-uri->identity-path (-> (and/c string? file-uri?) complete-path?)]
+           [source-id (-> Source? Source-Id?)]
+           [source-uri (-> Source? string?)]
+           [source-file-path (-> Source? (or/c path? #f))]
+           [source-syntax-source (-> Source? (or/c path? string?))]
+           [source-location-uri (-> Source? (or/c path? string?) string?)]))
+
+;; Constructors stay private. IDs support `equal?` and hashing. A descriptor
+;; retains the original address and is not a table key.
+(struct Source-Id (value) #:transparent)
+(struct Source (uri id) #:transparent)
+
+;; Identity path of a file URI. Protocol code uses this when a later API
+;; takes a path. The original URI stays on the Source from `uri->source`.
+(define (file-uri->identity-path uri)
+  (normalize-source-path (uri->path uri)))
+
+;; File identity is a complete lexically normalized path. Any other scheme
+;; uses the complete URI, so query and fragment distinguish virtual sources.
+(define (uri->source uri)
+  (define address (string->immutable-string uri))
+  (Source address
+          (Source-Id (if (file-uri? address)
+                         (file-uri->identity-path address)
+                         address))))
+
+;; Relative paths use current-directory; callers with another base must complete
+;; them there before entry. Protocol callers retain their address with uri->source.
+(define (path->source path)
+  (define normalized (normalize-source-path path))
+  (Source (string->immutable-string (normalized-path->uri normalized))
+          (Source-Id normalized)))
+
+(define source-id Source-id)
+(define source-uri Source-uri)
+
+;; Check Syntax `syntax-source`: a file path, or the whole URI when virtual.
+(define (source-syntax-source source)
+  (Source-Id-value (source-id source)))
+
+(define (source-file-path source)
+  (define value (source-syntax-source source))
+  (and (path? value) value))
+
+;; Keep this source's URI when `location` matches its syntax-source after file
+;; path normalization, so aliases such as `file://localhost/...` survive.
+;; Foreign file paths get standard file URIs; other values pass through.
+(define (source-location-uri source location)
+  (cond
+    [(equal? (if (path? location) (normalize-source-path location) location)
+             (source-syntax-source source))
+     (source-uri source)]
+    [(path? location) (path->uri location)]
+    [else location]))

+#lang racket/base
+
+(provide current-deadline-milliseconds deadline-evt)
+
+;; The clock and alarm must use the same time base. Older Racket versions
+;; lack the monotonic clock or the two-argument alarm-evt.
+(define monotonic-milliseconds
+  (and (procedure-arity-includes? alarm-evt 2)
+       (dynamic-require 'racket/base 'current-inexact-monotonic-milliseconds
+                        (lambda () #f))))
+
+(define current-deadline-milliseconds
+  (or monotonic-milliseconds current-inexact-milliseconds))
+
+(define (deadline-evt deadline)
+  (if monotonic-milliseconds
+      (alarm-evt deadline #t)
+      (alarm-evt deadline)))

+# Source ownership and analysis lifetime
+
+The session consumer owns source authority, analysis attempts, available results,
+and publication. Disk readers and analyzers run privately and report products;
+only the consumer can accept them. Source identity, source revision, and attempt
+identity are separate: a revision is a source lifetime token, and retrying the
+same revision creates a new attempt.
+
+## Interfaces and responsibilities
+
+`source-controller.rkt` exposes commands for request threads:
+
+- `source-controller-observe-evt` acquires current source knowledge. For a file
+  without an open buffer, each command is an ordered read barrier: it cannot
+  reuse a disk read started before the consumer accepted that command. Concurrent
+  observations share the next read. Open buffers require no disk read.
+- `source-controller-analysis-evt` starts or joins analysis for a snapshot and
+  replies with `Analysis-Handle`. Its `reusable-summary` field contains optional
+  reusable immutable facts while the completion event is still pending. Its
+  `completion-evt` is a newly scheduled attempt, or the installed result's
+  completion when a current success is reused. A ready outcome takes precedence
+  over reusable facts, including failure and stop.
+- `source-controller-current-view-evt` asks the consumer whether a captured view
+  is still current. It does not observe the filesystem.
+
+Constructing a command event submits work immediately. Cancelling a request's
+wait does not cancel shared work. Request callers must check cancellation before
+submission and validate the target after waiting, including when using available
+facts. A source revision certifies the server's accepted observation, not an
+atomic filesystem transaction.
+
+Cross-file definition and hover observe the target once per request. They use
+that snapshot's analysis and perform a final owner view check without rereading
+disk. An observed target change or invalidated acquisition ends the request with
+RequestFailed; the query does not reacquire or retry. A subsequent query observes
+the target again. An external disk change that the server has not observed may
+therefore leave an in-flight query answering from its original snapshot. Opening
+a buffer during a pending disk read may complete acquisition with buffer text;
+once acquired, that view must remain eligible through the query's final check.
+Missing files, Check Syntax errors, and absent bindings supply no feature detail.
+Read/worker failures end the request. Changing or closing the requesting document
+ends it with ContentModified (-32801), including pending exact inlay-hint and
+semantic-token requests. Deadlines and shutdown end it without cancelling shared analysis.
+
+Binding lookup uses a complete lexically normalized native path, submodule list,
+phase+space, and identifier. Dot segments collapse without filesystem access,
+symlink resolution, or general case folding.
+There is no query restriction on submodules or phase+space: matching Check Syntax
+jump and definition-target callbacks suffice, including after upstream fixes.
+Missing or inconsistent upstream binding information gives no detail; the query
+does not fall back to a different submodule or phase. Target observation uses
+`path->source`. Incoming file URIs establish the same identity at entry while
+retaining their original URI for outputs, including disk snapshots. Analysis jump
+paths complete relative to its load directory before normalization. Other relative
+path callers use their current directory. Path-only outputs use standard `net/url`
+encoding of the normalized complete path. Decoding and normalizing those outputs
+recovers the source identity; original URI text need not match. Virtual identities
+retain the full URI, including query and fragment.
+
+The `owner` submodule exports operations for the session consumer only. Open
+registers the buffer, restores matching retained analysis, and schedules fresh
+analysis. Edit takes the registered buffer selected by the incoming URI, owns
+the write lock, invalidates eligibility before the supplied
+document mutation, and schedules the successor after releasing the lock. Its
+mutation callback updates text and client version and must not acquire the same
+buffer lock. Close handles retention, cancellation, and removal of publications.
+`source-controller-refresh-analysis!` joins active work or starts another attempt
+after completion; `source-controller-ensure-analysis!` also reuses a current
+completed success. The command queue accepts named operations and worker
+completions; it has no arbitrary callback command.
+
+`source-controller.rkt` owns command submission, reply handling, and consumer
+dispatch. `source-controller/source-owner.rkt` owns the private controller
+record, construction, source transitions, acquisition policy, revision validation,
+result routing, and shutdown ordering. The public interface calls semantic owner
+operations and re-exports the supported interfaces; it cannot access record
+fields or subsystem handles. The owner never imports the public interface.
+Lifecycle and acceptance policy stay together in the owner so their revision,
+locking, cancellation, and trace-transfer invariants remain local. Subsystems own
+private records and collections; none imports or receives the controller:
+
+- `workspace/source-store.rkt`: source authority, revisions, and change signals.
+- `disk-reader.rkt`: `Disk-Reader`, ordered per-source disk reads and waiters.
+- `analysis-scheduler.rkt`: `Analysis-Scheduler`, shared queued/running attempts,
+  FIFO dispatch, capacity, cancellation, and attempt completion.
+- `supervised-worker.rkt`: `Supervised-Worker`, resource ownership, timeout and
+  premature-exit detection. It suppresses worker stdout and releases resources
+  before reporting a result. Cancelling work does not kill its supervisor;
+  a resulting late message is rejected by the reader or scheduler.
+- `analysis-publisher.rkt`: `Analysis-Publisher`, document analysis installation,
+  workspace contributions, diagnostics, and Resyntax publication. Buffer
+  operations require the controller-held SafeDoc write lock.
+- `closed-analysis-cache.rkt`: `Closed-Analysis-Cache`, bounded completed analysis
+  owned while files are closed.
+- `completion-event.rkt`: `Completion-Event`, a single-owner first-value
+  broadcast event, including when that value is `#f`.
+
+Worker messages are opaque envelopes. Readers and schedulers check attempt
+identity before invoking a synchronous acceptance procedure on the consumer:
+
+- Disk acceptance receives the started view and read result, commits source
+  knowledge, cancels analysis when that view changes, and returns the observer
+  response plus the successor disk view. The reader then answers current waiters
+  and starts any queued read using that successor view.
+- Analysis acceptance receives the snapshot, kind, completion, parent completion
+  (for Resyntax), and result. The controller validates revision and executor
+  products, installs or discards analysis, and translates acceptance failures to
+  terminal outcomes. The scheduler removes the attempt and resolves its event
+  only after acceptance returns. Successful open-buffer analysis may enqueue
+  Resyntax during acceptance; dispatch occurs after the command finishes.
+
+These procedures run inline, do not wait for workers, and do not dispatch another
+controller command. They are internal acceptance boundaries, not request commands
+or a callback registry. Source replacement cancels affected work. The scheduler
+also checks queued snapshot eligibility immediately before launch. Availability
+lookup and reuse of completed success belong to the controller, not the scheduler.
+
+The controller receives its publication workspace through `#:workspace`.
+The default remains the process's `current-workspace`, also used by existing
+workspace requests. Injecting a different publication workspace alone does not
+create an isolated LSP session; the request layer must use that same workspace.
+
+## Available results and fresh completion
+
+`SafeDoc-available` holds a completed product and the snapshot it analyzed.
+`SafeDoc-analysis-completion` is the broadcast event for the attempt being
+joined—either a newly scheduled one or a reused completed success's event.
+Available analysis may answer queries while that event is pending. Restoring a
+product never completes that event or starts Resyntax.
+
+Only queued and running attempts occupy the scheduler's private attempt table. Every terminal
+attempt is removed. An accepted available result retains its completion event,
+so repeated acquisitions can reuse success without retaining the job. Resyntax
+acceptance compares its parent completion with the installed result's completion;
+same-revision retries cannot accept an old attempt's findings.
+
+Exact editor queries require available analysis under the current source
+revision; otherwise they wait for fresh completion. Fast local queries keep
+their adjusted-trace fallbacks. An `errors` outcome publishes current
+diagnostics and clears exact availability. A `failed` outcome or timeout also
+clears availability. The old trace may still support fast fallbacks, but cannot
+be retained as a completed success. Non-success attempts may be retried.
+
+## Close, restore, and retention
+
+Closing an eligible file detaches its trace from the old Doc, moves its completed
+product into closed retention, and clears the SafeDoc projections. Close also
+cancels pending jobs, signals the old revision, removes the active workspace
+contribution, and publishes empty diagnostics. Edits clear eligibility before
+adjusting the trace, so an unfinished edit cannot enter retained storage.
+
+Opening creates a new source revision. Exact text equality permits transferring
+a retained trace into the new buffer, installing its contribution, and publishing
+its Check Syntax diagnostics to the incoming URI. The restored available result
+has no fresh completion in that lifetime. Every open schedules fresh analysis;
+old completion events and Resyntax findings are never restored.
+
+Closed-target definition and hover requests observe saved text before acquisition.
+They may use matching retained facts while fresh analysis runs, then perform final
+view validation. Text equality does not establish dependency freshness:
+retained dependency information can remain stale until fresh analysis replaces it.
+Neither current revisions nor fresh completion track external dependency changes.
+
+Only closed files occupy retention: at most 64 entries by default, configurable
+with `#:closed-analysis-limit`. Results are keyed by source ID in a private hash. Insertion
+and successful text-matching lookups mark an entry most recently used; misses and
+text mismatches leave recency unchanged. Insertion beyond capacity evicts the
+least recently used result without changing source authority or live documents.
+Reopening removes the entry before checking its text and transferring its trace,
+so retained storage cannot keep a trace that a live document starts modifying.
+A zero limit disables retention; evicted sources must analyze again. Existing
+waiters retain their outcomes.
+Virtual sources never enter retention. Shutdown stops work and clears retention.
+
+`tests/lsp/source-controller-test.rkt` covers ordered observation through the
+production consumer. `analysis-controller-test.rkt` covers attempt identity,
+bounds, acceptance, available facts, cancellation, and URI preservation.
+`closed-analysis-test.rkt` covers restoration, dependency changes, and eviction.
+`closed-analysis-cache-test.rkt`, `disk-reader-test.rkt`,
+`analysis-scheduler-test.rkt`, and `supervised-worker-test.rkt` exercise subsystem
+interfaces, ownership, and completion ordering without exposing mutable records.
+
+Integration tests use the production consumer and its named commands or LSP
+messages. Tests that must order individual transitions or replay delayed worker
+messages own an isolated controller on the test thread and call the same owner
+operations directly. Assertions run on the test thread; command failures are
+values only where the test explicitly exercises that production contract.

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; `analysis-query` reads the buffer when an installed `Available-Analysis`
+;; matches the current source-view revision, and returns that response
+;; immediately. Otherwise it returns a thunk and leaves the wait to the
+;; caller. The deadline is fixed at this call, so time before the thunk runs
+;; counts against `current-analysis-request-timeout`.
+;;
+;; After the wait, an `Analysis-Outcome` of `errors` becomes a success
+;; response carrying `empty-result`. A changed or closed document becomes
+;; `ContentModified`. Deadline expiry, shutdown, and any other unsuccessful
+;; wake become `RequestFailed`.
+(require "../common/debug.rkt"
+         "../common/interfaces.rkt"
+         "../common/json-util.rkt"
+         "../common/time.rkt"
+         "../workspace/source-store.rkt"
+         "analysis.rkt"
+         "responses.rkt"
+         "safedoc.rkt"
+         "source-controller.rkt")
+
+(provide analysis-query current-analysis-request-timeout)
+
+;; Seconds allowed for one query, measured from the call to `analysis-query`.
+(define current-analysis-request-timeout (make-parameter 30))
+
+(define (analysis-failed-response request-id message reason)
+  (log-racket-langserver-info "Analysis request ~a failed: ~a: ~v" request-id message reason)
+  (error-response request-id ErrorCode-RequestFailed message))
+
+;; Call under the buffer read lock. The lock covers the revision check and
+;; `read-result`.
+(define (available-analysis-response safe-doc request-id read-result)
+  (define installed-analysis (SafeDoc-available safe-doc))
+  (define current-view (SafeDoc-source-view safe-doc))
+  (and installed-analysis current-view
+       (eq? (Source-Snapshot-revision (Available-Analysis-snapshot installed-analysis))
+            (Source-View-revision current-view))
+       (success-response request-id (->jsexpr (read-result (SafeDoc-doc safe-doc))))))
+
+;; `next-response` receives the awaited completion and the wake value. A
+;; response ends the wait. An event is the next completion to wait for, under
+;; the deadline given to this function. A raised value becomes a RequestFailed
+;; response.
+(define (wait-for-analysis completion view shutdown-evt deadline-ms next-response request-id)
+  (with-handlers ([(lambda (_) #t)
+                   (lambda (reason)
+                     (analysis-failed-response request-id "Analysis request failed" reason))])
+    (let loop ([awaited-completion completion])
+      (define wake-result
+        (and awaited-completion view
+             (sync awaited-completion (Source-View-changed view)
+                   shutdown-evt (deadline-evt deadline-ms))))
+      (define response-or-completion (next-response awaited-completion wake-result))
+      (if (evt? response-or-completion)
+          (loop response-or-completion)
+          response-or-completion))))
+
+(define (analysis-query safe-doc request-id read-result empty-result)
+  (define deadline-ms (+ (current-deadline-milliseconds)
+                         (* 1000 (current-analysis-request-timeout))))
+  (define shutdown-evt (source-controller-shutdown-evt (current-source-controller)))
+  (define-values (request-view initial-completion immediate-response)
+    (with-read-safedoc safe-doc
+      (lambda (locked-safe-doc)
+        (values (SafeDoc-source-view locked-safe-doc) (SafeDoc-analysis-completion locked-safe-doc)
+                (available-analysis-response locked-safe-doc request-id read-result)))))
+  (define (response-after-wake awaited-completion wake-result)
+    (with-read-safedoc safe-doc
+      (lambda (locked-safe-doc)
+        (define current-completion (SafeDoc-analysis-completion locked-safe-doc))
+        (cond
+          [(or (not request-view) (not (eq? request-view (SafeDoc-source-view locked-safe-doc))))
+           (error-response request-id ErrorCode-ContentModified "Document changed or closed")]
+          [(>= (current-deadline-milliseconds) deadline-ms)
+           (error-response request-id ErrorCode-RequestFailed "Analysis request deadline expired")]
+          [(sync/timeout 0 shutdown-evt)
+           (error-response request-id ErrorCode-RequestFailed "Server shut down")]
+          [(available-analysis-response locked-safe-doc request-id read-result) => values]
+          ;; The buffer's completion event changed during the wait. Wait on the
+          ;; new event. The wake value is from the completion this waiter held.
+          [(and current-completion (not (eq? awaited-completion current-completion)))
+           current-completion]
+          [(and (Analysis-Outcome? wake-result) (eq? 'errors (Analysis-Outcome-state wake-result)))
+           (success-response request-id (->jsexpr empty-result))]
+          [else (analysis-failed-response request-id "Check Syntax did not succeed" wake-result)]))))
+  (or immediate-response
+      (lambda ()
+        (wait-for-analysis initial-completion request-view shutdown-evt deadline-ms
+                           response-after-wake request-id))))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Check Syntax products, and the outcomes request threads wait for.
+;; `analyze-source` returns an `Analysis-Product`. The source controller
+;; keeps that product's trace. Request threads receive an `Analysis-Summary`
+;; or an `Analysis-Outcome`. Lifetime and reuse are in `analysis-lifecycle.md`.
+(require json
+         racket/class
+         racket/contract
+         racket/set
+         "../common/json-util.rkt"
+         "../common/interfaces.rkt"
+         "../doclib/doc.rkt"
+         "../doclib/hover.rkt"
+         "../doclib/check-syntax.rkt"
+         "../doclib/doc-trace.rkt"
+         "../doclib/internal-types.rkt"
+         "../workspace/source-store.rkt")
+
+(provide analyze-source
+         (struct-out Analysis-Summary)
+         (struct-out Analysis-Product)
+         (struct-out Analysis-Outcome)
+         (struct-out Available-Analysis)
+         (struct-out Analysis-Handle))
+
+;; Immutable definition and hover facts copied from a successful trace.
+(struct/contract Analysis-Summary
+  ([definition-ranges (hash/c Module-Binding? Range? #:immutable #t)]
+   [hover-summaries (hash/c Module-Binding? Hover-Code-Summary? #:immutable #t)])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; One Check Syntax run in a worker.
+;;
+;; succeeded?: True when this product's Check Syntax run reported success.
+;;   Worker and acceptance failures are `Analysis-Outcome` values.
+;; summary: Definition and hover facts, or `#f` when the run produced none.
+;; diagnostics: Diagnostic JSON with immutable strings. A run that produced
+;;   no facts still supplies the diagnostics it collected.
+;; trace: Mutable trace. The source controller is its only consumer.
+;; contribution: Workspace contribution after successful analysis of a file.
+;;   `#f` when the run produced no facts or the source has no file path.
+(struct/contract Analysis-Product
+  ([succeeded? boolean?]
+   [summary (or/c #f Analysis-Summary?)]
+   [diagnostics (listof jsexpr?)]
+   [trace (is-a?/c build-trace%)]
+   [contribution (or/c #f Doc-Contribution?)])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Terminal result of one Check Syntax or Resyntax attempt.
+;;
+;; state: `succeeded` when Check Syntax produced facts, or when Resyntax
+;;   finished. `errors` when Check Syntax finished without facts. `failed`
+;;   when the worker raised, exited, or timed out. `stopped` when the attempt
+;;   was cancelled or the source was no longer eligible.
+;; value: An `Analysis-Summary` after successful Check Syntax. `#f` after
+;;   Check Syntax errors or successful Resyntax. The reason after `failed`
+;;   or `stopped`.
+(struct/contract Analysis-Outcome
+  ([state (or/c 'succeeded 'errors 'failed 'stopped)]
+   [value any/c])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; A completed product installed for one snapshot. Queries may read it while
+;; a later attempt is still running.
+;;
+;; snapshot: The analyzed snapshot. Live-buffer exact queries compare its
+;;   revision with the current source view; closed-file reuse compares text.
+;; completion-evt: Broadcast event of the attempt that produced this product
+;;   in the current source lifetime. `#f` when the product was restored from
+;;   a closed file. Restoration leaves the fresh attempt, scheduled by open,
+;;   unfinished.
+(struct/contract Available-Analysis
+  ([snapshot Source-Snapshot?]
+   [product Analysis-Product?]
+   [completion-evt (or/c #f evt?)])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; What request threads receive when they acquire analysis. The trace stays
+;; with the source controller.
+;;
+;; reusable-summary: Installed `Analysis-Summary` the caller may use while
+;;   `completion-evt` is not yet ready. `#f` when no facts are installed, or
+;;   when that event is already ready. A ready outcome, including failure and
+;;   stop, is taken from the event.
+;; completion-evt: Broadcast event that yields an `Analysis-Outcome`. It is a
+;;   newly scheduled attempt, or the installed result's completion when that
+;;   success is reused. After using either field, the caller checks that the
+;;   source revision is still current.
+(struct/contract Analysis-Handle
+  ([reusable-summary (or/c #f Analysis-Summary?)]
+   [completion-evt evt?])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Diagnostic JSON may contain mutable strings from language extensions.
+;; Make strings immutable, and copy hashes and lists, before the product is
+;; shared. Later mutation of the worker's value leaves the shared diagnostics
+;; unchanged.
+(define (freeze-json value)
+  (cond
+    [(string? value) (string->immutable-string value)]
+    [(hash? value)
+     (for/hasheq ([(key field-value) (in-hash value)]) (values key (freeze-json field-value)))]
+    [(list? value) (map freeze-json value)]
+    [else value]))
+
+;; Run Check Syntax for `snapshot` on a private document. On success, install
+;; the trace on that document before copying definition and hover facts.
+;; Those extractors read the document after that installation.
+(define (analyze-source snapshot)
+  (define doc (make-source-doc (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot) (Source-Snapshot-text snapshot)))
+  (define check-syntax-result (doc-check-syntax doc))
+  (define trace (CSResult-trace check-syntax-result))
+  (define succeeded? (CSResult-succeed? check-syntax-result))
+  (define contribution (and succeeded? (send trace get-contribution)))
+  (when succeeded?
+    (doc-update-trace! doc trace contribution (Doc-version doc)))
+  (Analysis-Product succeeded?
+                    (and succeeded? (Analysis-Summary (doc-definition-ranges doc)
+                                                      (doc-hover-summaries doc)))
+                    (freeze-json (->jsexpr (set->list (send trace get-warn-diags))))
+                    trace contribution))

+(provide hover-query)

+(define (hover-query safe-doc id pos)
+  (define deadline (+ (current-deadline-milliseconds)
+                      (* 1000 (current-analysis-request-timeout))))

+  (define-values (view target card range)
+    (with-read-safedoc safe-doc
+      (lambda (sd)
+        (define doc (SafeDoc-doc sd))

+                ;; Documentation excludes a source snippet, so do not resolve

+                    (lambda (facts binding)

+                    compose)

+;; the target once and uses analysis for that snapshot. An observed target
+;; change ends the request; an unobserved disk change affects a later query.
+(require racket/contract
+         racket/match
+         "../../common/debug.rkt"
+         "../../common/interfaces.rkt"

+;; Immutable inputs for one request. The requesting view governs cancellation;
+;; the target view is acquired separately and governs obsolescence.

+  ([id (or/c number? string?)]
+   [controller Source-Controller?]
+   [deadline real?]
+   [view (or/c #f Source-View?)]
+   [target Module-Binding?]
+   [feature string?]
+   [shutdown evt?])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Both signals end the request; neither starts another attempt. Request-Stop
+;; carries no response because the handler recomputes cancellation priority.
+(struct/contract Request-Stop () #:transparent)
+(struct/contract Target-Failure
+  ([stage string?]
+   [detail any/c])
+  #:transparent)
+

+  (match-define (struct* Target-Request ([id id] [view view] [deadline deadline]

+    [(or (not view) (sync/timeout 0 (Source-View-changed view)))
+     (error-response id ErrorCode-ContentModified "Document changed or closed")]
+    [(>= (current-deadline-milliseconds) deadline)
+     (error-response id ErrorCode-RequestFailed (string-append feature " request deadline expired"))]
+    [(sync/timeout 0 shutdown)
+     (error-response id ErrorCode-RequestFailed "Server shut down")]
+    [else #f]))
+
+(define (check-live! request [target-view #f])
+  (when (request-error request) (raise (Request-Stop)))
+  (when (and target-view (sync/timeout 0 (Source-View-changed target-view)))
+    (raise (Target-Failure "target changed" (Target-Request-target request)))))
+
+;; Constructing a controller event submits work. Delay it until after the
+;; liveness check, including when the deferred query was already expired.
+(define (wait-live request make-event [target-view #f])
+  (check-live! request target-view)
+  (define event (make-event))
+  (define result
+    (sync event (Target-Request-shutdown request) (deadline-evt (Target-Request-deadline request))
+          (Source-View-changed (Target-Request-view request))
+          (if target-view (Source-View-changed target-view) never-evt)))
+  (check-live! request target-view)

+    (raise (Target-Failure "source or analysis failed" (Source-Failure-reason result))))

+;; the acquired snapshot; target changes end the wait instead of retrying.

+  (match-define (struct* Target-Request ([controller controller] [target target] [feature feature]))

+  (when (Source-Result-error acquired)
+    (raise (Target-Failure "source read failed" (Source-Failure-reason (Source-Result-error acquired)))))
+  (case (Source-View-content-state view)
+    [(unknown) (raise (Target-Failure "target changed" 'invalidated-observation))]
+    [(file-not-found) #f]
+    [else
+     (define handle
+       (wait-live request
+                  (lambda () (source-controller-analysis-evt controller (Source-Result-snapshot acquired)))
+                  view))
+     (define available (Analysis-Handle-reusable-summary handle))
+     (define outcome
+       (if available
+           (Analysis-Outcome 'succeeded available)
+           (wait-live request (lambda () (Analysis-Handle-completion-evt handle)) view)))
+     (match outcome
+       [(struct* Analysis-Outcome ([state 'succeeded] [value facts]))
+        (define detail (lookup facts target))
+        (unless detail (log-racket-langserver-info "~a detail unavailable: ~v" feature target))
+        detail]
+       [(struct* Analysis-Outcome ([state 'errors]))
+        (log-racket-langserver-info "~a analysis reported errors for ~a: ~v"
+                                    feature (Module-Binding-filepath target) target)
+        #f]
+       [_ (raise (Target-Failure "analysis did not succeed" outcome))])]))
+
+(define (query-error-response request reason)
+  (or (request-error request)
+      (let ()
+        (define-values (stage detail)
+          (match reason
+            [(Target-Failure stage detail) (values stage detail)]
+            [_ (values "request failed" reason)]))
+        (define message (string-append (Target-Request-feature request) " " stage))
+        (log-racket-langserver-error "~a request failed for ~a: ~a: ~v"
+                                     (Target-Request-feature request)
+                                     (Module-Binding-filepath (Target-Request-target request)) message detail)
+        (error-response (Target-Request-id request) ErrorCode-RequestFailed message))))
+
+(define (execute-target-query request lookup compose)
+  (match-define (struct* Target-Request ([id id] [controller controller] [target target])) request)
+  (with-handlers ([(lambda (_) #t) (lambda (reason) (query-error-response request reason))])
+    (define acquired
+      (wait-live request
+                 (lambda ()
+                   (source-controller-observe-evt controller (path->source (Module-Binding-filepath target))))))
+    (define view (Source-Result-view acquired))
+    (check-live! request view)
+    (define detail (resolve-detail request acquired lookup))
+    ;; Validate the accepted observation, including missing files and reusable
+    ;; facts. This owner check does not read disk a second time.
+    (unless (wait-live request (lambda () (source-controller-current-view-evt controller view)) view)
+      (raise (Target-Failure "target changed" target)))
+    (define value (compose (Source-Result-snapshot acquired) detail))
+    (check-live! request view)
+    (success/enc id value)))
+
+;; Return a deferred response for one observation. `view` belongs to the
+;; requester. `deadline` is captured by the caller; waits do not cancel shared
+;; analysis. Missing files, syntax errors and absent bindings give no detail.
+;;
+;; lookup: (summary binding) -> detail or #f.
+;; compose: (snapshot detail) -> success payload. Missing files pass #f for
+;; both; a present detail always has its snapshot. Failures skip compose.
+(define (target-query id controller deadline view target feature lookup compose)
+  (define request
+    (Target-Request id controller deadline view target feature (source-controller-shutdown-evt controller)))
+  (lambda () (execute-target-query request lookup compose)))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Public command interface for the source controller. Request threads submit
+;; named commands and wait; the consumer dispatches them to the private source
+;; owner. No source state or subsystem handle is exposed here.
+(require racket/async-channel
+         racket/contract
+         racket/match
+         "../common/source.rkt"
+         "../workspace/source-store.rkt"
+         "source-controller/completion-event.rkt"
+         "source-controller/source-owner.rkt")
+
+(provide make-source-controller
+         Source-Controller?
+         current-source-controller
+         source-controller-events
+         source-controller-observe-evt
+         source-controller-analysis-evt
+         source-controller-current-view-evt
+         source-controller-shutdown-evt
+         (struct-out Analysis-Handle)
+         (struct-out Source-Result)
+         (struct-out Source-Failure)
+         (struct-out Disk-Missing))
+
+;; These operations run only on the session consumer. Request threads use the
+;; named commands above.
+(module+ owner
+  (provide source-controller-handle!
+           source-controller-open!
+           source-controller-edit!
+           source-controller-close!
+           source-controller-invalidate!
+           source-controller-set-notifier!
+           source-controller-shutdown!
+           source-controller-view
+           source-controller-snapshot
+           source-controller-ensure-analysis!
+           source-controller-refresh-analysis!))
+
+;; Commands on `events`, beside worker completions. Request threads never
+;; construct these records; the functions below submit them.
+;;
+;; reply: The submitter's one-shot wait, completed by the consumer in
+;;   `answer!`. Shared by every command below.
+
+;; Current source knowledge. The consumer may complete `reply` with a
+;; `Source-Result`, or with a further read completion that the observe
+;; wrapper waits through.
+(struct/contract Observe
+  ([source Source?]
+   [reply Completion-Event?])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Start or join analysis for `snapshot`. Completes `reply` with
+;; `Analysis-Handle`.
+(struct/contract Acquire-Analysis
+  ([snapshot Source-Snapshot?]
+   [reply Completion-Event?])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Whether `view` is still this source's current view. Completes `reply` with
+;; a boolean. Does not read disk.
+(struct/contract Validate-View
+  ([view Source-View?]
+   [reply Completion-Event?])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Puts the command on the consumer queue immediately. The returned event is
+;; the reply, or `Source-Failure` `'shutdown` if the controller stops first.
+(define (submit controller make-command)
+  (define reply (make-completion-event))
+  (async-channel-put (source-controller-events controller) (make-command reply))
+  (choice-evt reply
+              (wrap-evt (source-controller-shutdown-evt controller)
+                        (lambda (_) (Source-Failure 'shutdown)))))
+
+;; Current source knowledge. An open buffer replies with a `Source-Result`. A
+;; virtual source with no open buffer replies with a `Source-Result` whose
+;; `error` is `closed`. A disk file replies with the completion for its read:
+;; this command cannot join a read that started before the consumer accepted
+;; it, so overlapping observers share the next read. `replace-evt` waits
+;; through that inner event.
+(define (source-controller-observe-evt controller source)
+  (replace-evt (submit controller (lambda (reply) (Observe source reply)))
+               (lambda (result) (if (Completion-Event? result) result (ready-evt result)))))
+
+;; Start or join analysis for `snapshot`. The reply is `Analysis-Handle`:
+;; optional reusable facts plus the completion event for the joined attempt.
+(define (source-controller-analysis-evt controller snapshot)
+  (submit controller (lambda (reply) (Acquire-Analysis snapshot reply))))
+
+;; Whether `view` is still this source's current view. Does not read disk.
+(define (source-controller-current-view-evt controller view)
+  (submit controller (lambda (reply) (Validate-View view reply))))
+
+;; Complete `reply` with `proc`'s value. Shutdown and uncaught exceptions both
+;; become `Source-Failure`, so request threads never see a raised owner error.
+(define (answer! controller reply proc)
+  (resolve-completion! reply
+                       (if (source-controller-stopped? controller)
+                           (Source-Failure 'shutdown)
+                           (with-handlers ([(lambda (_) #t) Source-Failure])
+                             (proc)))))
+
+;; One dispatch finishes its source transition before queued analysis starts.
+;; Worker completions use the same owner and acceptance ordering as commands.
+(define (source-controller-handle! controller event)
+  (match event
+    [(Observe source reply)
+     (answer! controller reply (lambda () (source-controller-observe! controller source)))]
+    [(Acquire-Analysis snapshot reply)
+     (answer! controller reply (lambda () (source-controller-acquire-analysis! controller snapshot)))]
+    [(Validate-View view reply)
+     (answer! controller reply (lambda () (source-controller-current-view? controller view)))]
+    [_ (source-controller-handle-completion! controller event)])
+  (source-controller-pump! controller))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Effects of accepted analysis: document projections, workspace contributions,
+;; and diagnostics. The controller chooses eligibility and destination. Buffer
+;; operations below require its SafeDoc write lock; they never acquire it again.
+(require racket/contract
+         "../../common/json-util.rkt"
+         "../../common/source.rkt"
+         "../../doclib/doc.rkt"
+         "../../workspace/state.rkt"
+         "../analysis.rkt"
+         "../safedoc.rkt")
+
+(provide Analysis-Publisher?
+         make-analysis-publisher
+         set-analysis-notifier!
+         publish-document-analysis!
+         publish-document-resyntax!
+         withdraw-document-analysis!)
+
+(struct/contract Analysis-Publisher
+  ([workspace Workspace?]
+   [(notify #:mutable) (-> string? any/c any/c)]))
+
+(define (make-analysis-publisher workspace)
+  (Analysis-Publisher workspace (lambda (_method _params) (void))))
+
+(define (set-analysis-notifier! publisher notify)
+  (set-Analysis-Publisher-notify! publisher notify))
+
+(define (publish-diagnostics! publisher uri diagnostics)
+  ((Analysis-Publisher-notify publisher) "textDocument/publishDiagnostics"
+                                         (hasheq 'uri uri 'diagnostics diagnostics)))
+
+;; A restored product has no fresh completion. Source errors clear exact
+;; availability while preserving the old trace for approximate local queries.
+(define (publish-document-analysis! publisher sd snapshot product [completion #f])
+  (define doc (SafeDoc-doc sd))
+  (cond
+    [(Analysis-Product-succeeded? product)
+     (define contribution (Analysis-Product-contribution product))
+     (doc-update-trace! doc (Analysis-Product-trace product) contribution (Doc-version doc))
+     (set-SafeDoc-available! sd (Available-Analysis snapshot product completion))
+     (when contribution
+       (workspace-set-contribution! (Analysis-Publisher-workspace publisher) contribution))]
+    [else (set-SafeDoc-available! sd #f)])
+  (publish-diagnostics! publisher (Doc-uri doc) (Analysis-Product-diagnostics product)))
+
+;; Completion identity distinguishes same-revision retries. Old Resyntax
+;; findings cannot apply to a restored product or a later accepted attempt.
+(define (publish-document-resyntax! publisher sd parent-completion results)
+  (define available (SafeDoc-available sd))
+  (when (and available (eq? parent-completion (Available-Analysis-completion-evt available)))
+    (define doc (SafeDoc-doc sd))
+    (doc-update-resyntax-result! doc results)
+    (publish-diagnostics! publisher (Doc-uri doc) (->jsexpr (doc-diagnostics doc)))))
+
+;; Keep the opened URI spelling; a path cannot reconstruct it.
+(define (withdraw-document-analysis! publisher source uri)
+  (when (source-file-path source)
+    (workspace-remove-path! (Analysis-Publisher-workspace publisher) (source-file-path source)))
+  (publish-diagnostics! publisher uri '()))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Single-owner scheduling of analysis and Resyntax. Attempts, their queue,
+;; and worker handles stay private; callers hold only completion events.
+(require racket/async-channel
+         racket/contract
+         "../../common/source.rkt"
+         "../../workspace/source-store.rkt"
+         "../analysis.rkt"
+         "completion-event.rkt"
+         "supervised-worker.rkt")
+
+(provide Analysis-Scheduler?
+         make-analysis-scheduler
+         scheduled-analysis-event
+         request-analysis!
+         schedule-resyntax!
+         cancel-source-analysis!
+         stop-analysis-scheduler!
+         pump-analysis-scheduler!
+         Analysis-Completed?
+         finish-analysis-task!)
+
+;; parent-completion identifies the accepted analysis refined by Resyntax.
+;; worker is #f until execution starts. Terminal attempts leave the registry.
+(struct/contract Analysis-Attempt
+  ([snapshot Source-Snapshot?]
+   [kind (or/c 'analysis 'resyntax)]
+   [parent-completion (or/c #f evt?)]
+   [completion Completion-Event?]
+   [(state #:mutable) (or/c 'queued 'running 'terminal)]
+   [(worker #:mutable) (or/c #f Supervised-Worker?)]))
+
+(struct/contract Analysis-Scheduler
+  ([events async-channel?]
+   [analyze (-> Source-Snapshot? Analysis-Product?)]
+   [resyntax (or/c #f (-> string? string? list?))]
+   [timeout (and/c real? (>=/c 0))]
+   [slots exact-positive-integer?]
+   [attempts (hash/c (cons/c Source-Id? (or/c 'analysis 'resyntax))
+                     Analysis-Attempt? #:immutable #f)]
+   [(queue #:mutable) (listof Analysis-Attempt?)]
+   [(stopped? #:mutable) boolean?]))
+
+;; The event envelope carries an identity privately; replay cannot revive an
+;; attempt removed by completion, cancellation, or a same-revision retry.
+(struct Analysis-Completed (attempt result))
+
+(define (make-analysis-scheduler events #:analyze analyze #:resyntax resyntax
+                                 #:timeout [timeout 90] #:slots [slots 4])
+  (Analysis-Scheduler events analyze resyntax timeout slots (make-hash) '() #f))
+
+(define (attempt-key attempt)
+  (cons (Source-Snapshot-id (Analysis-Attempt-snapshot attempt))
+        (Analysis-Attempt-kind attempt)))
+
+(define (registered? scheduler attempt)
+  (eq? attempt (hash-ref (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler) (attempt-key attempt) #f)))
+
+(define (scheduled-analysis-event scheduler source)
+  (define attempt
+    (hash-ref (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler) (cons (source-id source) 'analysis) #f))
+  (and attempt (Analysis-Attempt-completion attempt)))
+
+(define (enqueue! scheduler snapshot kind parent-completion)
+  (define attempt
+    (Analysis-Attempt snapshot kind parent-completion (make-completion-event) 'queued #f))
+  (hash-set! (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler) (attempt-key attempt) attempt)
+  (set-Analysis-Scheduler-queue! scheduler
+                                 (append (Analysis-Scheduler-queue scheduler) (list attempt)))
+  (Analysis-Attempt-completion attempt))
+
+;; Requests for the same revision share an attempt. A successor revision
+;; supersedes outstanding work for this source, including its Resyntax.
+(define (request-analysis! scheduler snapshot)
+  (define source (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot))
+  (define active
+    (hash-ref (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler) (cons (source-id source) 'analysis) #f))
+  (cond
+    [(Analysis-Scheduler-stopped? scheduler) (ready-evt (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped 'shutdown))]
+    [(and active
+          (eq? (Source-Snapshot-revision snapshot)
+               (Source-Snapshot-revision (Analysis-Attempt-snapshot active))))
+     (Analysis-Attempt-completion active)]
+    [else
+     (cancel-source-analysis! scheduler source)
+     (enqueue! scheduler snapshot 'analysis #f)]))
+
+(define (schedule-resyntax! scheduler snapshot parent-completion)
+  (when (and (not (Analysis-Scheduler-stopped? scheduler))
+             (Analysis-Scheduler-resyntax scheduler))
+    (define previous
+      (hash-ref (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler) (cons (Source-Snapshot-id snapshot) 'resyntax) #f))
+    (when previous (settle! scheduler previous (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped 'superseded)))
+    (enqueue! scheduler snapshot 'resyntax parent-completion))
+  (void))
+
+(define (settle! scheduler attempt outcome)
+  (unless (eq? 'terminal (Analysis-Attempt-state attempt))
+    (when (Analysis-Attempt-worker attempt)
+      (stop-supervised-worker! (Analysis-Attempt-worker attempt)))
+    (set-Analysis-Attempt-state! attempt 'terminal)
+    (when (registered? scheduler attempt)
+      (hash-remove! (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler) (attempt-key attempt)))
+    (resolve-completion! (Analysis-Attempt-completion attempt) outcome)))
+
+(define (cancel-source-analysis! scheduler source [reason 'source-changed])
+  (for ([kind (in-list '(analysis resyntax))])
+    (define attempt
+      (hash-ref (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler) (cons (source-id source) kind) #f))
+    (when attempt (settle! scheduler attempt (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped reason))))
+  (set-Analysis-Scheduler-queue!
+    scheduler (filter (lambda (attempt) (registered? scheduler attempt))
+                      (Analysis-Scheduler-queue scheduler))))
+
+(define (stop-analysis-scheduler! scheduler)
+  (set-Analysis-Scheduler-stopped?! scheduler #t)
+  (for ([attempt (in-list (hash-values (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler)))])
+    (settle! scheduler attempt (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped 'shutdown)))
+  (set-Analysis-Scheduler-queue! scheduler '()))
+
+;; current? checks source eligibility at dispatch, after any time spent queued.
+;; It receives a snapshot and never receives the scheduler's private state.
+(define (pump-analysis-scheduler! scheduler current?)
+  (unless (Analysis-Scheduler-stopped? scheduler)
+    (let loop ()
+      (define queue (Analysis-Scheduler-queue scheduler))
+      (define running
+        (for/sum ([attempt (in-hash-values (Analysis-Scheduler-attempts scheduler))]
+                  #:when (eq? 'running (Analysis-Attempt-state attempt)))
+          1))
+      (when (and (pair? queue) (< running (Analysis-Scheduler-slots scheduler)))
+        (define attempt (car queue))
+        (set-Analysis-Scheduler-queue! scheduler (cdr queue))
+        (if (and (registered? scheduler attempt)
+                 (current? (Analysis-Attempt-snapshot attempt)))
+            (start-attempt! scheduler attempt)
+            (settle! scheduler attempt (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped 'source-changed)))
+        (loop)))))
+
+(define (start-attempt! scheduler attempt)
+  (define snapshot (Analysis-Attempt-snapshot attempt))
+  (set-Analysis-Attempt-state! attempt 'running)
+  (define analysis? (eq? 'analysis (Analysis-Attempt-kind attempt)))
+  (define worker
+    (start-supervised-worker!
+      (Analysis-Scheduler-events scheduler) (Analysis-Scheduler-timeout scheduler)
+      (if analysis?
+          (lambda () ((Analysis-Scheduler-analyze scheduler) snapshot))
+          (lambda () ((Analysis-Scheduler-resyntax scheduler)
+                      (Source-Snapshot-text snapshot) (Source-Snapshot-uri snapshot))))
+      #:fail (lambda (reason) (Analysis-Outcome 'failed reason))
+      #:exited 'worker-exited
+      #:timed-out 'analysis-timeout
+      #:done (lambda (result) (Analysis-Completed attempt result))))
+  (set-Analysis-Attempt-worker! attempt worker))
+
+;; accept runs inline for the current running attempt only. It receives
+;; snapshot, kind, completion, parent-completion, and worker result, and returns
+;; an Analysis-Outcome after installing/discarding the result and translating
+;; domain failures. Only then may the shared completion become ready.
+(define (finish-analysis-task! scheduler message accept)
+  (define attempt (Analysis-Completed-attempt message))
+  (when (and (registered? scheduler attempt) (eq? 'running (Analysis-Attempt-state attempt)))
+    (define outcome
+      (accept (Analysis-Attempt-snapshot attempt) (Analysis-Attempt-kind attempt)
+              (Analysis-Attempt-completion attempt) (Analysis-Attempt-parent-completion attempt)
+              (Analysis-Completed-result message)))
+    (settle! scheduler attempt outcome)))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Bounded LRU storage for completed analysis of closed files. The controller's
+;; consumer serializes every operation, including lookups that refresh recency.
+;; Callers establish file-only eligibility and detach live traces before insertion.
+(require racket/contract
+         "../../common/source.rkt"
+         "../../workspace/source-store.rkt"
+         "../analysis.rkt")
+
+(provide Closed-Analysis-Cache?
+         (contract-out
+           [make-closed-analysis-cache (-> exact-nonnegative-integer? Closed-Analysis-Cache?)]
+           [store-closed-analysis! (-> Closed-Analysis-Cache? Available-Analysis? void?)]
+           [find-closed-analysis!
+            (-> Closed-Analysis-Cache? Source-Snapshot? (or/c Available-Analysis? #f))]
+           [take-closed-analysis! (-> Closed-Analysis-Cache? Source? (or/c Available-Analysis? #f))]
+           [discard-closed-analysis! (-> Closed-Analysis-Cache? Source? void?)]
+           [clear-closed-analysis! (-> Closed-Analysis-Cache? void?)]))
+
+(struct/contract Cached-Analysis
+  ([use-order exact-nonnegative-integer?]
+   [analysis Available-Analysis?]))
+
+;; The hash is the only collection of retained results. Each insertion or
+;; successful match gets a unique use-order. Eviction scans this small bounded
+;; table rather than maintaining a separate eviction queue.
+(struct/contract Closed-Analysis-Cache
+  ([limit exact-nonnegative-integer?]
+   [(next-use-order #:mutable) exact-nonnegative-integer?]
+   [entries (hash/c Source-Id? Cached-Analysis? #:immutable #f)]))
+
+(define (make-closed-analysis-cache limit)
+  (Closed-Analysis-Cache limit 0 (make-hash)))
+
+(define (record-use! cache analysis)
+  (define order (Closed-Analysis-Cache-next-use-order cache))
+  (hash-set! (Closed-Analysis-Cache-entries cache)
+             (Source-Snapshot-id (Available-Analysis-snapshot analysis))
+             (Cached-Analysis order analysis))
+  (set-Closed-Analysis-Cache-next-use-order! cache (add1 order)))
+
+(define (store-closed-analysis! cache analysis)
+  (unless (zero? (Closed-Analysis-Cache-limit cache))
+    (record-use! cache analysis)
+    (define entries (Closed-Analysis-Cache-entries cache))
+    (when (> (hash-count entries) (Closed-Analysis-Cache-limit cache))
+      (define-values (oldest-id _oldest-order)
+        (for/fold ([oldest-id #f] [oldest-order +inf.0])
+                  ([(id entry) (in-hash entries)])
+          (define order (Cached-Analysis-use-order entry))
+          (if (< order oldest-order)
+              (values id order)
+              (values oldest-id oldest-order))))
+      (hash-remove! entries oldest-id))))
+
+;; Close creates a new revision, so reuse compares exact text, not revisions.
+;; Matching text does not establish freshness of imported dependencies. A miss
+;; or a text mismatch leaves recency unchanged.
+(define (find-closed-analysis! cache snapshot)
+  (define entry (hash-ref (Closed-Analysis-Cache-entries cache) (Source-Snapshot-id snapshot) #f))
+  (define analysis (and entry (Cached-Analysis-analysis entry)))
+  (cond
+    [(and analysis
+          (equal? (Source-Snapshot-text snapshot)
+                  (Source-Snapshot-text (Available-Analysis-snapshot analysis))))
+     (record-use! cache analysis)
+     analysis]
+    [else #f]))
+
+;; Remove before handing the mutable trace to a live buffer. Reopening takes
+;; the entry even when its text will not match the new buffer.
+(define (take-closed-analysis! cache source)
+  (define entries (Closed-Analysis-Cache-entries cache))
+  (define id (source-id source))
+  (define entry (hash-ref entries id #f))
+  (hash-remove! entries id)
+  (and entry (Cached-Analysis-analysis entry)))
+
+;; Discarding or evicting a result does not change source authority, live
+;; documents, or completion events already held by waiters.
+(define (discard-closed-analysis! cache source)
+  (hash-remove! (Closed-Analysis-Cache-entries cache) (source-id source)))
+
+(define (clear-closed-analysis! cache)
+  (hash-clear! (Closed-Analysis-Cache-entries cache))
+  (set-Closed-Analysis-Cache-next-use-order! cache 0))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; A single owner resolves the event; any number of waiters receive its first value.
+(provide Completion-Event? make-completion-event resolve-completion! ready-evt evt-ready?)
+
+(struct Completion-Event (result ready)
+  #:property prop:evt
+  (lambda (completion)
+    (wrap-evt (semaphore-peek-evt (Completion-Event-ready completion))
+              (lambda (_) (unbox (Completion-Event-result completion))))))
+
+(define (make-completion-event)
+  (Completion-Event (box #f) (make-semaphore 0)))
+
+(define (resolve-completion! completion result)
+  (unless (evt-ready? (semaphore-peek-evt (Completion-Event-ready completion)))
+    (set-box! (Completion-Event-result completion) result)
+    (semaphore-post (Completion-Event-ready completion))))
+
+(define (ready-evt value)
+  (wrap-evt always-evt (lambda (_) value)))
+
+;; Readiness does not depend on whether the event produces #f.
+(define (evt-ready? event)
+  (sync/timeout 0 (wrap-evt event (lambda (_) #t))))

+;; Ordered disk observations, owned by one consumer. Commands accepted during
+;; an active read share its successor; only the consumer decides what an
+;; observation means for source authority and the response to its waiters.

+         racket/file
+         "../../common/source.rkt"
+         (only-in "../../workspace/source-store.rkt" Source-View? Source-View-source)
+         "completion-event.rkt"
+         "supervised-worker.rkt")
+
+(provide Disk-Reader?
+         Disk-Read-Completed?
+         (struct-out Disk-Missing)
+         (struct-out Disk-Read-Failure)
+         (contract-out
+           [make-disk-reader
+            (->* (async-channel?)
+                 (#:read (-> path? any/c) #:timeout (and/c real? (>=/c 0)))
+                 Disk-Reader?)]
+           [read-source-text (-> path? (or/c string? Disk-Missing?))]
+           [request-disk-read! (-> Disk-Reader? Source-View? Completion-Event?)]
+           [finish-disk-read!
+            (-> Disk-Reader? Disk-Read-Completed?
+                (-> Source-View? any/c (values any/c Source-View?)) void?)]
+           [cancel-disk-read! (-> Disk-Reader? Source? any/c void?)]
+           [stop-disk-reader! (-> Disk-Reader? any/c void?)]))
+
+(struct/contract Disk-Missing () #:transparent)
+
+(struct/contract Disk-Read-Failure ([reason any/c]) #:transparent)
+
+;; All records below are private. Attempt identity rejects messages left in
+;; the channel after cancellation, including when a new lane has the same id.
+(struct/contract Read-Attempt
+  ([started-view Source-View?]
+   [completion Completion-Event?]
+   [worker (or/c Supervised-Worker? #f)])
+  #:mutable)
+
+(struct/contract Read-Lane
+  ([active Read-Attempt?]
+   [pending (or/c Completion-Event? #f)])
+  #:mutable)
+
+(struct/contract Disk-Reader
+  ([events async-channel?]
+   [read (-> path? any/c)]
+   [timeout (and/c real? (>=/c 0))]
+   [lanes (hash/c Source-Id? Read-Lane? #:immutable #f)]
+   [stopped? boolean?]
+   [stop-response any/c])
+  #:mutable)
+
+(struct/contract Disk-Read-Completed
+  ([source Source?]
+   [attempt Read-Attempt?]
+   [result (or/c string? Disk-Missing? Disk-Read-Failure?)]))
+
+(define (make-disk-reader events #:read [read read-source-text] #:timeout [timeout 3])
+  (Disk-Reader events read timeout (make-hash) #f #f))

+        (define result ((Disk-Reader-read reader) (source-file-path source)))

+          [(string? result) (string->immutable-string result)]

+          [else (Disk-Read-Failure result)]))

+      #:exited 'reader-exited
+      #:timed-out 'read-timeout
+      #:done (lambda (result) (Disk-Read-Completed source attempt result))))
+  (set-Read-Attempt-worker! attempt worker)
+  attempt)

+        (unless (Read-Lane-pending lane)
+          (set-Read-Lane-pending! lane (make-completion-event)))
+        (Read-Lane-pending lane)]

+    (resolve-completion! (Read-Attempt-completion attempt) response)

+       (set-Read-Lane-active! lane (start-read! reader current-view pending))]

+

+  (define active (Read-Lane-active lane))
+  (stop-supervised-worker! (Read-Attempt-worker active))
+  (resolve-completion! (Read-Attempt-completion active) response)

+  (define lanes (Disk-Reader-lanes reader))
+  (define key (source-id source))
+  (define lane (hash-ref lanes key #f))
+  (when lane
+    (hash-remove! lanes key)
+    (cancel-lane! lane response))
+  (void))
+
+(define (stop-disk-reader! reader response)
+  (unless (Disk-Reader-stopped? reader)
+    (set-Disk-Reader-stopped?! reader #t)
+    (set-Disk-Reader-stop-response! reader response)
+    (define lanes (Disk-Reader-lanes reader))
+    (define abandoned (hash-values lanes))
+    (hash-clear! lanes)
+    (for ([lane (in-list abandoned)])
+      (cancel-lane! lane response)))
+  (void))
