+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Consumer-only source ownership and acceptance policy. This module keeps the
+;; controller record private and coordinates its isolated subsystems. Command
+;; transport lives in ../source-controller.rkt; dependencies point toward this
+;; owner, never back to that public interface. See ../analysis-lifecycle.md.
+(require racket/async-channel
+         racket/class
+         racket/contract
+         racket/match
+         "../../common/debug.rkt"
+         "../../common/source.rkt"
+         "../../common/settings.rkt"
+         "../../doclib/doc.rkt"
+         "../../doclib/external/resyntax.rkt"
+         "../../workspace/source-store.rkt"
+         "../../workspace/current.rkt"
+         "../analysis.rkt"
+         "../safedoc.rkt"
+         "../resyntax-place.rkt"
+         "analysis-scheduler.rkt"
+         "analysis-publisher.rkt"
+         "closed-analysis-cache.rkt"
+         "completion-event.rkt"
+         "disk-reader.rkt")
+
+(provide make-source-controller
+         Source-Controller?
+         current-source-controller
+         source-controller-events
+         source-controller-shutdown-evt
+         source-controller-stopped?
+         source-controller-observe!
+         source-controller-acquire-analysis!
+         source-controller-current-view?
+         source-controller-handle-completion!
+         source-controller-pump!
+         source-controller-open!
+         source-controller-edit!
+         source-controller-close!
+         source-controller-invalidate!
+         source-controller-set-notifier!
+         source-controller-shutdown!
+         source-controller-view
+         source-controller-snapshot
+         source-controller-ensure-analysis!
+         source-controller-refresh-analysis!
+         (struct-out Analysis-Handle)
+         (struct-out Source-Result)
+         (struct-out Source-Failure)
+         (struct-out Disk-Missing))
+
+;; Failed command or disk read. `reason` is a symbol such as `shutdown`,
+;; `closed`, `reader-exited`, or `read-timeout`, or the value raised while
+;; handling the command or reading the source.
+(struct/contract Source-Failure
+  ([reason any/c])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Current knowledge of one source after observation.
+;;
+;; view: Present for every file, including failed or missing reads. `#f` only
+;;   for a virtual source with no open buffer.
+;; snapshot: Frozen text when buffer or disk text is available; otherwise `#f`.
+;; error: Failure of this observation (`closed`, `reader-exited`, `read-timeout`,
+;;   or a raised reader error). Shutdown is reported as a bare `Source-Failure`
+;;   on the command reply, not in this field. A missing file is `file-not-found`
+;;   on the view, with no error.
+(struct/contract Source-Result
+  ([view (or/c #f Source-View?)]
+   [snapshot (or/c #f Source-Snapshot?)]
+   [error (or/c #f Source-Failure?)])
+  #:transparent)
+
+;; Private composition root. Subsystem representations and mutable fields
+;; are available only through their own operations.
+(struct/contract Source-Controller
+  ([store Source-Store?]
+   [events async-channel?]
+   [shutdown semaphore?]
+   [reader Disk-Reader?]
+   [scheduler Analysis-Scheduler?]
+   [closed-analysis Closed-Analysis-Cache?]
+   [publisher Analysis-Publisher?]))
+
+;; Timeouts are seconds. The workspace supplies publication only, not session
+;; isolation for request-layer workspace access. Zero cache capacity disables
+;; closed-file retention; #f Resyntax disables its follow-on work.
+(define (make-source-controller #:workspace [workspace current-workspace]
+                                #:read [read read-source-text]
+                                #:read-timeout [read-timeout 3]
+                                #:analyze [analyze analyze-source]
+                                #:analysis-slots [slots 4]
+                                #:analysis-timeout [analysis-timeout 90]
+                                #:closed-analysis-limit [closed-analysis-limit 64]
+                                #:resyntax [resyntax (and (resyntax-available?) run-resyntax/in-place)])
+  (define events (make-async-channel))
+  (Source-Controller (make-source-store) events (make-semaphore 0)
+                     (make-disk-reader events #:read read #:timeout read-timeout)
+                     (make-analysis-scheduler events #:analyze analyze #:resyntax resyntax
+                                              #:slots slots #:timeout analysis-timeout)
+                     (make-closed-analysis-cache closed-analysis-limit)
+                     (make-analysis-publisher workspace)))
+
+(define current-source-controller (make-parameter (make-source-controller)))
+
+(define (source-controller-set-notifier! controller notify)
+  (set-analysis-notifier! (Source-Controller-publisher controller) notify))
+
+(define (source-controller-events controller)
+  (Source-Controller-events controller))
+
+(define (source-controller-shutdown-evt controller)
+  (semaphore-peek-evt (Source-Controller-shutdown controller)))
+
+(define (source-controller-stopped? controller)
+  (evt-ready? (source-controller-shutdown-evt controller)))
+
+(define (source-buffer controller source)
+  (source-store-buffer (Source-Controller-store controller) source))
+
+(define (source-controller-view controller source)
+  (source-store-view (Source-Controller-store controller) source))
+
+;; Buffer text under the SafeDoc lock, or cached disk text. `#f` when the
+;; source is closed and virtual, or a file whose disk content is unknown or
+;; missing.
+(define (source-controller-snapshot controller source)
+  (define buffer (source-buffer controller source))
+  (if buffer
+      (with-read-safedoc buffer
+        (lambda (sd)
+          (define doc (SafeDoc-doc sd))
+          (Source-Snapshot (Doc-source doc) (Source-View-revision (SafeDoc-source-view sd)) 'buffer
+                           (string->immutable-string (doc-get-text doc)))))
+      (source-store-disk-snapshot (Source-Controller-store controller) source)))
+
+(define (current-result controller source [error #f])
+  (Source-Result (source-controller-view controller source)
+                 (source-controller-snapshot controller source) error))
+
+(define (snapshot-current? controller snapshot)
+  (define view (source-controller-view controller (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot)))
+  (and view
+       (eq? (Source-Snapshot-revision snapshot)
+            (Source-View-revision view))))
+
+;; Worker envelopes are interpreted here so the public dispatcher has no
+;; dependency on reader/scheduler representations. Acceptance still runs inline.
+(define (source-controller-handle-completion! controller event)
+  (match event
+    [(? Disk-Read-Completed?)
+     (finish-disk-read! (Source-Controller-reader controller) event
+                        (lambda (view result) (accept-disk-observation! controller view result)))]
+    [(? Analysis-Completed?)
+     (finish-analysis-task! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller) event
+                            (lambda (snapshot kind completion parent result)
+                              (accept-analysis-result! controller snapshot kind completion parent result)))]))
+
+(define (source-controller-current-view? controller view)
+  (eq? view (source-controller-view controller (Source-View-source view))))
+
+(define (source-controller-pump! controller)
+  (pump-analysis-scheduler! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller)
+                            (lambda (snapshot) (snapshot-current? controller snapshot))))
+
+(define (source-controller-observe! controller source)
+  (match (source-controller-view controller source)
+    [#f (current-result controller source (Source-Failure 'closed))]
+    [(struct* Source-View ([origin 'buffer])) (current-result controller source)]
+    [view (request-disk-read! (Source-Controller-reader controller) view)]))
+
+;; Commit source knowledge and invalidate obsolete analysis before the reader
+;; answers observers or starts the next read from the successor disk view.
+(define (accept-disk-observation! controller started-view result)
+  (define source (Source-View-source started-view))
+  (define-values (content-state text error)
+    (match result
+      [(? string? text) (values 'text-available text #f)]
+      [(Disk-Missing) (values 'file-not-found #f #f)]
+      [(Disk-Read-Failure reason) (values 'unknown #f (Source-Failure reason))]))
+  (source-store-observe! (Source-Controller-store controller) started-view content-state text)
+  (define next-view (source-controller-view controller source))
+  (unless (eq? started-view next-view)
+    (cancel-source-analysis! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller) source))
+  (values (current-result controller source error) next-view))
+
+(define (cancel-read! controller source)
+  (cancel-disk-read! (Source-Controller-reader controller) source (current-result controller source)))
+
+;; Availability and freshness cross buffers, closed storage, and scheduling;
+;; that policy belongs here rather than in the scheduler.
+(define (available-analysis controller snapshot)
+  (define buffer (source-buffer controller (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot)))
+  (if buffer
+      (with-read-safedoc buffer SafeDoc-available)
+      (find-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller) snapshot)))
+
+(define (reusable-completion controller snapshot)
+  (define available (available-analysis controller snapshot))
+  (and available
+       (eq? (Source-Snapshot-revision snapshot)
+            (Source-Snapshot-revision (Available-Analysis-snapshot available)))
+       (Available-Analysis-completion-evt available)))
+
+(define (source-controller-ensure-analysis! controller snapshot #:refresh? [refresh? #f])
+  (cond
+    [(or (source-controller-stopped? controller) (not (snapshot-current? controller snapshot)))
+     (ready-evt (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped 'ineligible))]
+    [else
+     (define source (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot))
+     (define scheduler (Source-Controller-scheduler controller))
+     (define active (scheduled-analysis-event scheduler source))
+     (define reused (and (not refresh?) (not active) (reusable-completion controller snapshot)))
+     (define event (or reused (request-analysis! scheduler snapshot)))
+     (define buffer (source-buffer controller source))
+     (when buffer
+       (with-write-safedoc buffer (lambda (sd) (set-SafeDoc-analysis-completion! sd event))))
+     (source-controller-pump! controller)
+     event]))
+
+(define (source-controller-acquire-analysis! controller snapshot)
+  (define event (source-controller-ensure-analysis! controller snapshot))
+  (define available (and (not (evt-ready? event)) (available-analysis controller snapshot)))
+  (Analysis-Handle
+    (and available (Analysis-Product-summary (Available-Analysis-product available))) event))
+
+(define (source-controller-refresh-analysis! controller source)
+  (define snapshot (source-controller-snapshot controller source))
+  (when snapshot (source-controller-ensure-analysis! controller snapshot #:refresh? #t))
+  (void))
+
+(define (discard-analysis! controller source)
+  (discard-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller) source)
+  (define buffer (source-buffer controller source))
+  (when buffer
+    (with-write-safedoc buffer (lambda (sd) (set-SafeDoc-available! sd #f)))))
+
+(define (record-analysis! controller snapshot product completion)
+  (define source (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot))
+  (define succeeded? (Analysis-Product-succeeded? product))
+  (define contribution (Analysis-Product-contribution product))
+  ;; Validate injected executor products at acceptance for both destinations.
+  (when (and succeeded?
+             (not (and (Analysis-Product-summary product)
+                       (if (source-file-path source) contribution (not contribution)))))
+    (error 'record-analysis! "successful analysis requires facts and a file-only contribution"))
+  (define buffer (source-buffer controller source))
+  (cond
+    [buffer
+     (with-write-safedoc buffer
+       (lambda (sd)
+         (publish-document-analysis! (Source-Controller-publisher controller)
+                                     sd snapshot product completion)))]
+    [(and succeeded? (eq? 'disk (Source-Snapshot-origin snapshot)))
+     (store-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller)
+                             (Available-Analysis snapshot product completion))])
+  (Analysis-Outcome (if succeeded? 'succeeded 'errors) (Analysis-Product-summary product)))
+
+;; A handled acceptance failure clears exact eligibility before the scheduler
+;; broadcasts failure. Mutable traces are never returned to request threads.
+(define (accept-analysis-result! controller snapshot kind completion parent result)
+  (define source (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot))
+  (define outcome
+    (with-handlers ([(lambda (_) #t) (lambda (reason) (Analysis-Outcome 'failed reason))])
+      (cond
+        [(not (snapshot-current? controller snapshot)) (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped 'source-changed)]
+        [(Analysis-Outcome? result) result]
+        [(eq? kind 'analysis) (record-analysis! controller snapshot result completion)]
+        [else
+         (define buffer (source-buffer controller source))
+         (when buffer
+           (with-write-safedoc buffer
+             (lambda (sd)
+               (publish-document-resyntax! (Source-Controller-publisher controller) sd parent result))))
+         (Analysis-Outcome 'succeeded #f)])))
+  (define succeeded? (eq? 'succeeded (Analysis-Outcome-state outcome)))
+  (case kind
+    [(analysis)
+     (unless succeeded? (discard-analysis! controller source))
+     (when (and succeeded? (source-buffer controller source) (get-resyntax-enabled))
+       (schedule-resyntax! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller) snapshot completion))]
+    [(resyntax)
+     (unless succeeded? (log-racket-langserver-info "Resyntax discarded: ~v" outcome))])
+  outcome)
+
+;; Register the buffer as a new revision. Matching closed-file text may restore
+;; its trace and diagnostics; restoration does not supply a completion event
+;; and does not restore Resyntax. Rebind the contribution to this open's source
+;; so publication uses the incoming URI. Always schedule a fresh attempt.
+(define (source-controller-open! controller source safe-doc)
+  (with-write-safedoc safe-doc
+    (lambda (sd)
+      (set-SafeDoc-source-view! sd
+                                (source-store-open! (Source-Controller-store controller)
+                                                    source sd))))
+  (cancel-source-analysis! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller) source)
+  (cancel-read! controller source)
+  ;; Take ownership even on a mismatch: an older text must not remain eligible
+  ;; after this buffer starts adjusting its trace.
+  (define available (take-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller) source))
+  (define snapshot (and available (source-controller-snapshot controller source)))
+  (when (and available
+             (equal? (Source-Snapshot-text snapshot)
+                     (Source-Snapshot-text (Available-Analysis-snapshot available))))
+    (define product (Available-Analysis-product available))
+    (define restored-product
+      (struct-copy Analysis-Product product
+        [contribution (send (Analysis-Product-trace product) get-contribution
+                            #:source (Source-Snapshot-source snapshot))]))
+    (with-write-safedoc safe-doc
+      (lambda (sd)
+        (publish-document-analysis! (Source-Controller-publisher controller) sd snapshot restored-product))))
+  (source-controller-refresh-analysis! controller source))
+
+;; Clear the buffer's fresh completion and available result. The document
+;; trace stays in place.
+(define (clear-analysis-projections! sd)
+  (set-SafeDoc-analysis-completion! sd #f)
+  (set-SafeDoc-available! sd #f))
+
+;; `safe-doc` is the already-registered buffer; this does not look up by URI.
+;; Invalidate eligibility before adjusting the mutable trace. The controller
+;; owns the lock and schedules the successor only after the whole edit is
+;; visible. `mutate-doc` receives the Doc, must update its text and client
+;; version, and must not acquire the same buffer lock.
+(define (source-controller-edit! controller safe-doc mutate-doc)
+  (define source
+    (with-write-safedoc safe-doc
+      (lambda (sd)
+        (define source (Doc-source (SafeDoc-doc sd)))
+        (set-SafeDoc-source-view!
+          sd (source-store-edit! (Source-Controller-store controller) source))
+        (clear-analysis-projections! sd)
+        (discard-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller) source)
+        (cancel-source-analysis! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller) source)
+        (mutate-doc (SafeDoc-doc sd))
+        source)))
+  (source-controller-refresh-analysis! controller source))
+
+;; Drop buffer authority without a read. File content becomes unknown; virtual
+;; sources are removed because they have no disk fallback. Retain a completed
+;; product only when it still matches the revision being closed. Capture the
+;; opened URI before clearing projections so empty diagnostics keep that
+;; spelling.
+(define (source-controller-close! controller source safe-doc)
+  (define uri
+    (with-write-safedoc safe-doc
+      (lambda (sd)
+        (define available (SafeDoc-available sd))
+        (define closed-view (source-store-close! (Source-Controller-store controller) source))
+        (when (and closed-view available
+                   (eq? (Source-Snapshot-revision (Available-Analysis-snapshot available))
+                        (Source-View-revision (SafeDoc-source-view sd))))
+          (doc-detach-analysis! (SafeDoc-doc sd))
+          (store-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller) available))
+        (set-SafeDoc-source-view! sd #f)
+        (clear-analysis-projections! sd)
+        (Doc-uri (SafeDoc-doc sd)))))
+  (cancel-source-analysis! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller) source)
+  (withdraw-document-analysis! (Source-Controller-publisher controller) source uri)
+  (cancel-read! controller source)
+  ;; Invalidation freed slots; start queued attempts for other sources.
+  (source-controller-pump! controller))
+
+;; Files only. Drop retained data and cached disk text. An open buffer keeps
+;; its document, gets a new revision, and is re-analyzed. A file without a
+;; buffer returns to unknown disk without reading.
+(define (source-controller-invalidate! controller source)
+  (when (source-file-path source)
+    (discard-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller) source)
+    (define store (Source-Controller-store controller))
+    (define buffer (source-store-buffer store source))
+    (if buffer
+        (with-write-safedoc buffer
+          (lambda (sd)
+            (set-SafeDoc-source-view! sd (source-store-invalidate! store source))
+            (clear-analysis-projections! sd)))
+        (source-store-invalidate! store source))
+    (cancel-source-analysis! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller) source)
+    (cancel-read! controller source)
+    (when buffer (source-controller-refresh-analysis! controller source))
+    ;; Invalidation freed slots; start queued attempts for other sources.
+    (source-controller-pump! controller)))
+
+;; Subsystems settle their own pending work; shutdown does not inspect tables,
+;; queues, lanes, attempts, workers, or completion-event representations.
+(define (source-controller-shutdown! controller)
+  (unless (source-controller-stopped? controller)
+    (semaphore-post (Source-Controller-shutdown controller))
+    (stop-analysis-scheduler! (Source-Controller-scheduler controller))
+    (stop-disk-reader! (Source-Controller-reader controller) (Source-Failure 'shutdown))
+    (clear-closed-analysis! (Source-Controller-closed-analysis controller))))

+#lang racket/base
+
+(require racket/async-channel
+         racket/port
+         "../../common/time.rkt")
+
+(provide Supervised-Worker? start-supervised-worker! stop-supervised-worker!)
+
+;; Only this module can access the worker's resource boundary. The owner serializes stops.
+(struct Supervised-Worker (custodian))
+
+(define (stop-supervised-worker! worker)
+  (custodian-shutdown-all (Supervised-Worker-custodian worker)))
+
+;; launch runs inside the resource boundary, including any parallel-thread pool it creates.
+;; The supervisor stays outside: work may shut down its own custodian before reporting.
+(define (start-supervised-worker! events seconds work
+                                  #:launch [launch thread]
+                                  #:fail fail
+                                  #:exited exited
+                                  #:timed-out timed-out
+                                  #:done done)
+  (define handle (Supervised-Worker (make-custodian)))
+  (define deadline (+ (current-deadline-milliseconds) (* 1000 seconds)))
+  (define result-ch (make-async-channel))
+  (define worker
+    (parameterize ([current-custodian (Supervised-Worker-custodian handle)]
+                   [current-output-port (open-output-nowhere)])
+      (launch (lambda ()
+                (async-channel-put result-ch
+                                   (with-handlers ([(lambda (_) #t) fail])
+                                     (work)))))))
+  (thread
+    (lambda ()
+      (define outcome
+        (sync result-ch
+              (wrap-evt (thread-dead-evt worker)
+                        (lambda (_)
+                          ;; Death and a queued result can both be ready. Boxing the poll
+                          ;; distinguishes a returned #f from an absent result.
+                          (define result (sync/timeout 0 (wrap-evt result-ch box)))
+                          (if result (unbox result) (fail exited))))
+              (wrap-evt (deadline-evt deadline) (lambda (_) (fail timed-out)))))
+      ;; Release resources before notifying the owner, even if done itself raises.
+      (stop-supervised-worker! handle)
+      (async-channel-put events (done outcome))))
+  handle)

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Source-store transitions with no controller and no disk. These checks cover
+;; observation, views captured at read start, and which text the store retains.
+(require "../../common/source.rkt"
+         "../../common/path-util.rkt"
+         rackunit
+         "../../workspace/source-store.rkt")
+
+(define path (build-path (current-directory) "source.rkt"))
+
+(define (changed? view)
+  (and (sync/timeout 0 (Source-View-changed view)) #t))
+
+(module+ test
+  (test-case "source contracts reject invalid metadata and mutable snapshot text"
+    (define revision (gensym 'revision))
+    (check-exn exn:fail:contract?
+               (lambda () (Source-View (path->source path) revision 'unknown 'text-available never-evt)))
+    (check-exn exn:fail:contract?
+               (lambda () (Source-View (path->source path) revision 'disk 'invalid-state never-evt)))
+    (check-exn exn:fail:contract?
+               (lambda () (Source-View (path->source path) revision 'disk 'text-available #f)))
+    (check-exn exn:fail:contract?
+               (lambda ()
+                 (Source-Snapshot (path->source path)
+                                  revision 'disk (string-copy "text"))))
+    (check-exn exn:fail:contract?
+               (lambda () (Source-Snapshot #f revision 'disk "text"))))
+
+  (test-case "virtual sources exist only while their buffer is open"
+    (define store (make-source-store))
+    (define source (uri->source "untitled:store-lifecycle"))
+    (define (check-absent)
+      (check-false (source-store-view store source))
+      (check-false (source-store-buffer store source))
+      (check-false (source-store-disk-snapshot store source))
+      (check-false (source-store-invalidate! store source))
+      (check-exn #rx"source is not open" (lambda () (source-store-edit! store source))))
+    (check-absent)
+    (check-false (source-store-close! store source))
+    (define buffer (box 'editable-text))
+    (define opened (source-store-open! store source buffer))
+    (check-eq? 'buffer (Source-View-origin opened))
+    (check-eq? buffer (source-store-buffer store source))
+    (check-eq? opened (source-store-invalidate! store source))
+    (check-false (source-store-close! store source))
+    (check-true (changed? opened))
+    (check-true (changed? opened) "all waiters retain the close signal")
+    (check-absent)
+    (check-false (source-store-observe! store opened 'text-available "late"))
+    (check-absent)
+    (check-false (source-store-close! store source))
+    (define reopened (source-store-open! store source buffer))
+    (check-not-eq? (Source-View-revision opened) (Source-View-revision reopened))
+    (check-false (changed? reopened))
+    (check-false (source-store-observe! store opened 'text-available "late"))
+    (check-eq? reopened (source-store-view store source)))
+
+  (test-case "invalid observations leave the current revision and text intact"
+    (define store (make-source-store))
+    (define source (path->source path))
+    (define current
+      (source-store-observe! store (source-store-view store source) 'text-available "kept"))
+    (for ([observation (in-list '((text-available #f)
+                                  (text-available 42)
+                                  (file-not-found "text")
+                                  (unknown "text")
+                                  (invalid-state #f)))])
+      (check-exn exn:fail:contract?
+                 (lambda () (apply source-store-observe! store current observation)))
+      (check-eq? current (source-store-view store source))
+      (check-false (changed? current))
+      (check-equal? "kept" (Source-Snapshot-text (source-store-disk-snapshot store source)))))
+
+  (test-case "unchanged exact disk text preserves a revision and broadcasts changes"
+    (define store (make-source-store))
+    (define initial (source-store-view store (path->source path)))
+    (check-eq? 'unknown (Source-View-content-state initial))
+    (define first (source-store-observe! store initial 'text-available "one"))
+    (check-true (changed? initial))
+    (check-true (changed? initial) "invalidation is persistent for all waiters")
+    (check-eq? first (source-store-observe! store first 'text-available (string-copy "one")))
+    (check-false (changed? first))
+    (define second (source-store-observe! store first 'text-available "two"))
+    (check-not-eq? (Source-View-revision first) (Source-View-revision second))
+    (check-true (changed? first))
+    (define snapshot (source-store-disk-snapshot store (path->source path)))
+    (check-equal? "two" (Source-Snapshot-text snapshot))
+    (check-true (immutable? (Source-Snapshot-text snapshot))))
+
+  (test-case "failed reads replace not-found observations with unknown content"
+    (define store (make-source-store))
+    (define missing
+      (source-store-observe! store (source-store-view store (path->source path)) 'file-not-found))
+    (check-eq? missing (source-store-observe! store missing 'file-not-found))
+    (check-false (source-store-disk-snapshot store (path->source path)))
+    (define unknown (source-store-observe! store missing 'unknown))
+    (check-true (changed? missing))
+    (check-eq? 'unknown (Source-View-content-state unknown))
+    (define failed-again (source-store-observe! store unknown 'unknown))
+    (check-true (changed? unknown))
+    (check-not-eq? unknown failed-again)
+    (define recreated (source-store-observe! store failed-again 'text-available "new"))
+    (check-true (changed? failed-again))
+    (check-eq? 'text-available (Source-View-content-state recreated)))
+
+  (test-case "close discards unsaved authority and rejects an old disk view"
+    (define store (make-source-store))
+    (define started-view (source-store-view store (path->source path)))
+    (define buffer (box 'editable-text))
+    (define opened (source-store-open! store (path->source path) buffer))
+    (check-eq? buffer (source-store-buffer store (path->source path)))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; End-to-end evidence for the prototype: real stdio frames and gated macro
+;; expansion. File markers establish ordering, not elapsed sleeps.
+(require json rackunit racket/async-channel racket/file racket/port
+         racket/path
+         racket/runtime-path racket/string
+         "../../common/path-util.rkt"
+         "../../common/interfaces.rkt"
+         "../../common/json-util.rkt"
+         "../../common/time.rkt"
+         "../../lsp/msg-io.rkt"
+         "../stdio-server.rkt")
+
+(define-runtime-path scratch-path "../../.agent-scratch")
+(define scratch (simplify-path scratch-path #f))
+
+(define (target-text root value)
+  (string-append
+    "#lang racket/base\n(provide shared)\n;; Target comment\n"
+    (format "(define shared ~a)\n" value)
+    "(require (for-syntax racket/base))\n"
+    "(define-syntax (probe stx)\n"
+    "  (displayln \"expansion stdout must be isolated\")\n"
+    (format "  (call-with-output-file ~s #:exists 'append\n"
+            (path->string (build-path root "expansions")))
+    "    (lambda (out) (displayln 'expanded out)))\n"
+    (format "  (when (file-exists? ~s)\n" (path->string (build-path root "hold")))
+    (format "    (call-with-output-file ~s #:exists 'truncate void)\n"
+            (path->string (build-path root "entered")))
+    "    (let wait ()\n"
+    (format "      (unless (file-exists? ~s) (sleep 0.01) (wait))))\n"
+            (path->string (build-path root "release")))
+    "  #'(void))\n(probe)\n"))
+
+(define (write-text path text) (display-to-file text path #:exists 'truncate))
+(define (count root) (length (file->lines (build-path root "expansions"))))
+
+(define (wait-entered root)
+  (define marker (build-path root "entered"))
+  (define deadline (+ (current-deadline-milliseconds) 20000))
+  (let loop ()
+    (unless (file-exists? marker)
+      (when (>= (current-deadline-milliseconds) deadline)
+        (error 'wait-entered "target did not reach expansion gate"))
+      (sleep 0.01)
+      (loop))))
+
+(module+ test
+  (test-case "real transport shares target facts, refreshes saves, and cancels held imports"
+    (make-directory* scratch)
+    (define root (make-temporary-file "background-protocol~a" 'directory scratch))
+    (dynamic-wind
+      void
+      (lambda ()
+        (define a (build-path root "a.rkt"))
+        (define b (build-path root "b.rkt"))
+        (define c (build-path root "c.rkt"))
+        (define a-uri (path->uri a))
+        (define b-uri (path->uri b))
+        (define c-uri (path->uri c))
+        (define a-text "#lang racket/base\n(require \"b.rkt\")\n(define local 1)\n(list shared local)\n")
+        (write-text a a-text)
+        (write-text b (target-text root 1))
+        (call-with-server-process
+          (lambda (server stdout stdin stderr)
+            (define messages (make-async-channel))
+            (define pending (make-hash))
+            (define diagnostics (make-hash))
+            (define frame-failure #f)
+            (thread (lambda () (copy-port stderr (open-output-nowhere))))
+            (define frame-reader
+              (thread
+                (lambda ()
+                  (with-handlers ([exn? (lambda (e)
+                                          (set! frame-failure e)
+                                          (async-channel-put messages e))])
+                    (let loop ()
+                      (define msg (read-frame stdout))
+                      (unless (eof-object? msg)
+                        (when (equal? (hash-ref msg 'method #f) "textDocument/publishDiagnostics")
+                          (hash-set! diagnostics (hash-ref (hash-ref msg 'params) 'uri) #t))
+                        (async-channel-put messages msg)
+                        (loop)))))))
+            (define (send! method params [id #f])
+              (define msg (hasheq 'jsonrpc "2.0" 'method method 'params params))
+              (display-message/flush (if id (hash-set msg 'id id) msg) stdin))
+            (define (response id)
+              (define deadline (+ (current-deadline-milliseconds) 20000))
+              (define result
+                (or (hash-ref pending id #f)
+                    (let loop ()
+                      (when (>= (current-deadline-milliseconds) deadline)
+                        (error 'response "response deadline expired for ~a" id))
+                      (define msg
+                        (sync/timeout (max 0 (/ (- deadline (current-deadline-milliseconds)) 1000))
+                                      messages))
+                      (unless msg (error 'response "no response for ~a" id))
+                      (when (exn? msg) (raise msg))
+                      (define received (hash-ref msg 'id #f))
+                      (cond [(equal? received id) msg]
+                            [else (when received (hash-set! pending received msg)) (loop)]))))
+              (hash-remove! pending id)
+              result)
+            (define (result id) (hash-ref (response id) 'result))
+            (define (open! uri text version)
+              (send! "textDocument/didOpen"
+                     (hasheq 'textDocument (hasheq 'uri uri 'languageId "racket"
+                                                   'version version 'text text))))
+            (define (query method id [uri a-uri] [pos (Pos 3 7)])
+              (send! method (hasheq 'textDocument (hasheq 'uri uri) 'position (->jsexpr pos)) id))
+            (define (check-definition id)
+              (check-equal? (result id)
+                            (->jsexpr (Location b-uri (Range (Pos 3 8) (Pos 3 14))))))
+            (define (check-hover id value)
+              (define hover (result id))
+              (check-equal? (hash-ref hover 'range) (->jsexpr (Range (Pos 3 6) (Pos 3 12))))
+              (check-true (string-contains? (hash-ref hover 'contents)
+                                            (format ";; Target comment\n(define shared ~a)" value))))
+            (send! "initialize" (hasheq 'processId (json-null) 'capabilities (hasheq)
+                                        'rootUri (json-null) 'rootPath (json-null)) 1)
+            (result 1)
+            (send! "workspace/didChangeConfiguration"
+                   (hasheq 'settings (hasheq 'racket-langserver
+                                             (hasheq 'resyntax (hasheq 'enable #f)))))
+            (open! a-uri a-text 0)
+            (send! "textDocument/semanticTokens/full" (hasheq 'textDocument (hasheq 'uri a-uri)) 2)
+            (result 2)
+            (define dependency-count (count root))
+            (write-text (build-path root "hold") "")
+            (query "textDocument/definition" 3)
+            (wait-entered root)
+            ;; The consumer processes both requests before release. Owner-side
+            ;; tests establish atomic joining; this barrier cannot observe whether
+            ;; the second deferred thread has joined yet.
+            (query "textDocument/hover" 4)
+            (send! "textDocument/hover" (hasheq) 90)
+            (check-true (hash-has-key? (response 90) 'error))
+            (check-equal? (- (count root) dependency-count) 1)
+            (write-text (build-path root "release") "")
+            (check-definition 3)
+            (check-hover 4 1)
+            (check-equal? (- (count root) dependency-count) 1)
+            (query "textDocument/hover" 5)
+            (check-hover 5 1)
+            (query "textDocument/definition" 6)
+            (check-definition 6)
+            (check-equal? (- (count root) dependency-count) 1)
+            ;; A save during analysis leaves this request on its acquired
+            ;; snapshot. The next query observes the new disk text.
+            (delete-file (build-path root "entered"))
+            (delete-file (build-path root "release"))
+            (write-text b (target-text root 2))
+            (query "textDocument/hover" 7)
+            (wait-entered root)
+            (write-text b (target-text root 3))
+            (write-text (build-path root "release") "")
+            (check-hover 7 2)
+            (check-equal? (- (count root) dependency-count) 2)
+            (query "textDocument/hover" 70)
+            (check-hover 70 3)
+            (check-equal? (- (count root) dependency-count) 3)
+            ;; B stays held while an independent C completes Check Syntax and local
+            ;; queries. An edit to A cancels its imported request before release.
+            (delete-file (build-path root "entered"))
+            (delete-file (build-path root "release"))
+            (write-text b (target-text root 4))
+            (query "textDocument/definition" 8)

+         "../../workspace/api.rkt"

+         (only-in "../../lsp/source-controller/analysis-scheduler.rkt" Analysis-Completed?)
+         "controller-support.rkt"
+         "../lib/resyntax-place-test-support.rkt")
+
+(define text "#lang racket/base\n(define value 1)\nvalue\n")
+
+(define (controlled-analyzer probes)
+  (lambda (snapshot)
+    (match (wait-at-gate probes snapshot)
+      ['raise (raise 'arbitrary-analysis-failure)]
+      ['die
+       ;; Use an external killer so parallel self-kill scheduling cannot
+       ;; turn the intended worker-exited outcome into a timeout.
+       (define worker (current-thread))
+       (thread (lambda () (kill-thread worker)))
+       (sync never-evt)]
+      [_ (analyze-source snapshot)])))
+
+(define (request session method id path)
+  (request! session id method path
+            (hasheq 'range (hasheq 'start (hasheq 'line 0 'character 0)
+                                   'end (hasheq 'line 3 'character 0)))))
+
+(define (notifications session)
+  (let loop ([messages '()])
+    (define msg (sync/timeout 0 (Session-notifications session)))
+    (if msg (loop (cons msg messages)) (reverse messages))))
+
+(define (with-buffer controller path proc)
+  (define custodian (make-custodian))
+  (parameterize ([current-custodian custodian]
+                 [current-source-controller controller])

+  (define (await event)

+    (define scheduler

+                    (async-channel-get release)
+                    (analyze-source snapshot))))
+    (dynamic-wind

+      (lambda ()

+  (define (accept-success snapshot kind completion parent product)

+        (define first (request-analysis! scheduler a))
+        (define second (request-analysis! scheduler b))
+        (check-eq? first (request-analysis! scheduler a))
+        (pump-analysis-scheduler! scheduler (lambda (_) #t))
+        (check-eq? (await started) a)
+        (check-false (sync/timeout 0 started))
+        (async-channel-put release #t)
+        (finish-analysis-task! scheduler (await events) accept-success)
+        (check-eq? (Analysis-Outcome-state (await first)) 'succeeded)
+        (check-false (scheduled-analysis-event scheduler (Source-Snapshot-source a)))
+        (pump-analysis-scheduler! scheduler (lambda (_) #t))
+        (check-eq? (await started) b)
+        (async-channel-put release #t)
+        (finish-analysis-task! scheduler (await events) accept-success)

+        (check-eq? (Analysis-Outcome-state (await first)) 'failed)
+        (define retry (request-analysis! scheduler a))

+        (stop-analysis-scheduler! scheduler)
+        (check-eq? (Analysis-Outcome-state (await queued)) 'stopped)

+#lang racket/base

+;; Gates prove that restored editor results precede fresh expansion completion.
+(require "../../common/source.rkt"

+         racket/file
+         racket/list

+         racket/string
+         "../../common/interfaces.rkt"

+         "../../lsp/source-controller.rkt"
+         "../../workspace/source-store.rkt"
+         "controller-support.rkt")
+
+(define (analyzer gates)
+  (lambda (snapshot)
+    (case (wait-at-gate gates snapshot)
+      [(fail) (raise 'refresh-failed)]
+      [(errors)
+       (define product (analyze-source snapshot))
+       (Analysis-Product #f #f (list (hasheq 'message "fresh analysis error"))
+                         (Analysis-Product-trace product) #f)]
+      [else (analyze-source snapshot)])))
+
+;; Real expansion can exceed the short waits used for gate coordination.
+(define (await-analysis event)
+  (await event 90))
+
+(define (open-analyzed! session gates path text [version 0])
+  (open! session path text version)
+  (release-gate! (await gates))
+  (barrier session)
+  (check-eq? 'succeeded (Analysis-Outcome-state (await-analysis (acquire session path)))))
+
+(define (available session path)
+  (define snapshot (Source-Result-snapshot (observation session path)))
+  (Analysis-Handle-reusable-summary
+    (await (source-controller-analysis-evt (Session-controller session) snapshot))))
+
+(define (query session path id method [position (Pos 3 0)])
+  (request! session id method path
+            (hasheq 'position (->jsexpr position) 'range (->jsexpr (Range (Pos 0 0) (Pos 20 0)))))
+  (hash-ref (response session id) 'result))
+
+(define (with-files proc)
+  (make-directory* scratch)
+  (define root (make-temporary-file "closed-analysis~a" 'directory scratch))
+  (dynamic-wind void (lambda () (proc root)) (lambda () (delete-directory/files root))))
+
+(define (write-text path text)
+  (display-to-file text path #:exists 'truncate))
+
+(define typed-text
+  "#lang typed/racket\n(struct point ([x : Integer] [y : Integer]))\n(define p (let ([unused 0]) (point 1 2)))\np\n")
+
+(module+ test
+  (test-case "real Typed Racket types, navigation, tokens, hints and diagnostics restore before refresh"
+    (define gates (make-async-channel))
+    (with-session (make-source-controller #:analyze (analyzer gates) #:resyntax #f)
+                  (lambda (session)
+                    (define path (build-path scratch "closed-typed.rkt"))
+                    (open-analyzed! session gates path typed-text 7)
+                    (define methods (list "textDocument/hover" "textDocument/definition"
+                                          "textDocument/semanticTokens/full" "textDocument/inlayHint"))
+                    (define results (for/list ([method (in-list methods)] [id (in-naturals 400)])
+                                      (query session path id method)))
+                    (check-true (string-contains? (hash-ref (first results) 'contents) "**Type**"))
+                    (check-equal? (second results)
+                                  (->jsexpr (Location (path->uri path) (Range (Pos 2 8) (Pos 2 9)))))
+                    (check-true (pair? (hash-ref (third results) 'data)))
+                    (check-true (pair? (fourth results)))
+                    (define diagnostics (hash-ref (hash-ref (await (Session-notifications session)) 'params)
+                                                  'diagnostics))
+                    (check-not-false
+                      (member "unused variable" (map (lambda (d) (hash-ref d 'message)) diagnostics)))
+                    (close! session path)
+                    (barrier session)
+                    (await (Session-notifications session))
+                    (open! session path typed-text 7)
+                    (define held (await gates))
+                    (barrier session)
+                    (define fresh (acquire session path))
+                    (for ([method (in-list methods)] [expected (in-list results)] [id (in-naturals 410)])
+                      (check-equal? (query session path id method) expected))
+                    (check-equal? (hash-ref (hash-ref (await (Session-notifications session)) 'params)
+                                            'diagnostics) diagnostics)
+                    (check-false (sync/timeout 0 fresh))

+    (with-session (make-source-controller #:analyze (analyzer gates) #:resyntax #f #:closed-analysis-limit 1)
+                  (lambda (session)
+                    (define a (build-path scratch "eviction-a.rkt"))
+                    (define b (build-path scratch "eviction-b.rkt"))
+                    (define live (build-path scratch "eviction-live.rkt"))
+                    (for ([path (in-list (list live a b))])

+                      (unless (equal? path live) (close! session path) (barrier session)))
+                    (check-true (pair? (hash-ref (query session live 420 "textDocument/semanticTokens/full") 'data)))
+                    (open! session a text)
+                    (define cold (await gates))
+                    (barrier session)

+                    (release-gate! cold)
+                    (await-analysis (acquire session a))

+                    (barrier session)

+                    (release-gate! warm)

+                      (barrier session)

+                      (await gates)

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Controller observations, queue barriers, and held work for injected-controller tests.
+;; Session ownership and protocol helpers live in the existing shared test client.
+(require rackunit

+#lang racket/base
+
+(require rackunit
+         racket/async-channel
+         "../../common/source.rkt"

+(module+ test
+  (define source (path->source (string->path "/disk-reader-test.rkt")))
+  (define (view)
+    (Source-View source (gensym 'revision) 'disk 'unknown never-evt))
+  (define (await event)
+    (define result (sync/timeout 3 (wrap-evt event box)))
+    (unless result (error 'await "event did not become ready"))
+    (unbox result))
+  (define (next-message events)
+    (define message (await events))
+    (check-pred Disk-Read-Completed? message)
+    message)
+
+  (define (with-reader events read proc)
+    (define custodian (make-custodian))
+    (define reader (make-disk-reader events #:read read))
+    (dynamic-wind
+      void
+      (lambda () (parameterize ([current-custodian custodian]) (proc reader)))
+      (lambda ()
+        (stop-disk-reader! reader 'shutdown)
+        (custodian-shutdown-all custodian))))
+
+  (test-case "queued commands share successor read and capture accepted successor view"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (define calls (make-async-channel))
+    (define replies (make-async-channel))
+    (with-reader
+      events
+      (lambda (path) (async-channel-put calls path) (async-channel-get replies))
+      (lambda (reader)
+        (define initial (view))
+        (define successor (view))
+        (define first (request-disk-read! reader initial))
+        (check-equal? (await calls) (source-file-path source))
+        (define second (request-disk-read! reader initial))
+        (check-eq? second (request-disk-read! reader initial))
+        (check-not-eq? first second)
+        (async-channel-put replies (string-copy "first"))
+        (define message (next-message events))
+        (finish-disk-read!
+          reader message
+          (lambda (started result)
+            (check-eq? started initial)
+            (check-equal? result "first")
+            (check-true (immutable? result))
+            (check-false (evt-ready? first))
+            (check-false (evt-ready? second))
+            (values 'accepted successor)))
+        (check-eq? (await first) 'accepted)
+        (check-equal? (await calls) (source-file-path source))
+        (check-false (evt-ready? second))
+        (async-channel-put replies "second")
+        (finish-disk-read!
+          reader (next-message events)
+          (lambda (started result)
+            (check-eq? started successor)
+            (check-equal? result "second")
+            (values 'successor-accepted successor)))
+        (check-eq? (await second) 'successor-accepted))))
+
+  (test-case "cancel answers both generations and rejects stale completion against a new lane"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (with-reader
+      events (lambda (_) "disk")
+      (lambda (reader)
+        (define initial (view))
+        (define first (request-disk-read! reader initial))
+        (define pending (request-disk-read! reader initial))
+        ;; Retain an actual worker message so replay exercises attempt identity.
+        (define stale (next-message events))
+        (cancel-disk-read! reader source 'cancelled)
+        (check-eq? (await first) 'cancelled)
+        (check-eq? (await pending) 'cancelled)
+        (define fresh (request-disk-read! reader initial))
+        (finish-disk-read! reader stale (lambda (_started _result)
+                                          (fail "cancelled observation was accepted")
+                                          (values #f initial)))
+        (check-false (evt-ready? fresh))
+        (finish-disk-read! reader (next-message events)
+                           (lambda (_started _result) (values 'fresh initial)))
+        (check-eq? (await fresh) 'fresh)
+        (stop-disk-reader! reader 'shutdown)
+        (check-eq? (await (request-disk-read! reader initial)) 'shutdown))))
+
+  (test-case "malformed injected results become disk failures"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (with-reader
+      events (lambda (_) '(bad result))
+      (lambda (reader)
+        (define initial (view))
+        (define completion (request-disk-read! reader initial))
+        (finish-disk-read! reader (next-message events)
+                           (lambda (_started result)
+                             (check-equal? result (Disk-Read-Failure '(bad result)))
+                             (values 'failed initial)))
+        (check-eq? (await completion) 'failed)))))

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Source-controller checks through the production consumer. The test holds
+;; disk reads, so ordering does not depend on sleeps. A direct process-message
+;; call would skip the client and internal event pump.
+(require "../../common/source.rkt"
+         rackunit
+         racket/async-channel
+         racket/contract
+         racket/file
+         racket/match
+         racket/path
+         "../../common/path-util.rkt"
+         "../../lsp/analysis.rkt"
+         "../../lsp/source-controller.rkt"
+         (only-in "../../lsp/source-controller/disk-reader.rkt" read-source-text)
+         "../../workspace/source-store.rkt"
+         "controller-support.rkt")
+
+(struct/contract Probe ([path path?] [release async-channel?]) #:transparent)
+
+(define (controlled-controller probes #:timeout [timeout 90])
+  (make-source-controller
+    #:read-timeout timeout
+    #:read (lambda (path)
+             (define release (make-async-channel))
+             (async-channel-put probes (Probe path release))
+             (match (async-channel-get release)
+               ['raise (raise 'arbitrary-read-failure)]
+               ['die (kill-thread (current-thread))]
+               [value value]))))
+
+(define (release! probe value)
+  (async-channel-put (Probe-release probe) value))
+
+(define (result-text result)
+  (Source-Snapshot-text (Source-Result-snapshot result)))
+

+#lang racket/base
+
+(require rackunit
+         racket/async-channel
+         racket/port
+         "../../lsp/source-controller/completion-event.rkt"
+         "../../lsp/source-controller/supervised-worker.rkt")
+
+;; All assertions run on the test thread; background threads only report observations.
+(define (await event)
+  (define result (sync/timeout 3 (wrap-evt event box)))
+  (unless result (error 'await "event did not become ready"))
+  (unbox result))
+
+(define (start events work #:seconds [seconds 2] #:launch [launch thread])
+  (start-supervised-worker! events seconds work
+                            #:launch launch
+                            #:fail (lambda (reason) (list 'failed reason))
+                            #:exited 'exited
+                            #:timed-out 'timeout
+                            #:done values))
+
+(module+ test
+  (test-case "completion preserves its first false result for multiple and later readers"
+    (define completion (make-completion-event))
+    (define replies (make-async-channel))
+    (check-true (Completion-Event? completion))
+    (check-false (evt-ready? completion))
+    (for ([_ (in-range 4)])
+      (thread (lambda () (async-channel-put replies (sync completion)))))
+    (resolve-completion! completion #f)
+    (resolve-completion! completion 'replacement)
+    (for ([_ (in-range 4)])
+      (check-false (await replies)))
+    (check-true (evt-ready? completion))
+    (check-false (await completion))
+    (check-true (evt-ready? (ready-evt #f)))
+    (check-false (await (ready-evt #f))))
+
+  (test-case "a dead worker's queued false result wins over premature exit"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (define handle
+      (start events (lambda () #f)
+             #:launch (lambda (thunk)
+                        (define worker (thread thunk))
+                        (await (thread-dead-evt worker))
+                        worker)))
+    (check-true (Supervised-Worker? handle))
+    (check-false (await events))
+    (stop-supervised-worker! handle))
+
+  (test-case "raised values become failures"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (start events (lambda () (raise 'raised-value)))
+    (check-equal? (await events) '(failed raised-value)))
+
+  (test-case "timeout releases child resources before reporting"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (define started (make-async-channel))
+    (define handle
+      (start events
+             (lambda ()
+               (define child (thread (lambda () (sync never-evt))))
+               (async-channel-put started child)
+               (sync never-evt))
+             #:seconds 0.1))
+    (define child (await started))
+    (check-equal? (await events) '(failed timeout))
+    (check-true (thread-dead? child))
+    (stop-supervised-worker! handle))
+
+  (test-case "cancellation is idempotent and releases child resources"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (define started (make-async-channel))
+    (define handle
+      (start events
+             (lambda ()
+               (define child (thread (lambda () (sync never-evt))))
+               (async-channel-put started child)
+               (sync never-evt))))
+    (define child (await started))
+    (stop-supervised-worker! handle)
+    (stop-supervised-worker! handle)
+    (check-true (thread-dead? child))
+    (check-equal? (await events) '(failed exited)))
+
+  (test-case "the supervisor survives work shutting down its own custodian"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (start events (lambda () (custodian-shutdown-all (current-custodian))))
+    (check-equal? (await events) '(failed exited)))
+
+  (test-case "worker and launch stdout cannot reach the caller's output"
+    (define events (make-async-channel))
+    (define output (open-output-string))
+    (parameterize ([current-output-port output])
+      (start events (lambda () (display "worker output") 'finished)
+             #:launch (lambda (thunk) (display "launch output") (thread thunk))))
+    (check-equal? (await events) 'finished)
+    (check-equal? (get-output-string output) "")))

+(define (module-text name)
+  (format "#lang racket/base\n(require racket/list)\n(define (~a unused) (first '(1)))\n(~a 2)\n" name name))
+
+(define (analyzed session uri)
+  (define event (acquire session (uri->source uri)))
+  (check-eq? 'succeeded (Analysis-Outcome-state (await event))))
+
+(define (feature session id method uri [extra (hasheq)])
+  (request! session id method uri extra)
+  (response session id))
+
+(define (check-local-results session uri)
+  (define position (hasheq 'position (hasheq 'line 3 'character 1)))
+  (define definition (feature session 1 "textDocument/definition" uri position))
+  (check-equal? (hash-ref (hash-ref definition 'result) 'uri) uri)
+  (define references
+    (feature session 2 "textDocument/references" uri
+             (hash-set position 'context (hasheq 'includeDeclaration #t))))
+  (check-equal? (length (hash-ref references 'result)) 2)
+  (for ([location (in-list (hash-ref references 'result))])
+    (check-equal? (hash-ref location 'uri) uri))
+  (define rename
+    (feature session 3 "textDocument/rename" uri (hash-set position 'newName "renamed")))
+  (check-equal? (hash-keys (hash-ref (hash-ref rename 'result) 'changes))
+                (list (string->symbol uri)))
+  (define actions
+    (feature session 4 "textDocument/codeAction" uri
+             (hasheq 'range (hasheq 'start (hasheq 'line 2 'character 0)
+                                    'end (hasheq 'line 2 'character 40))
+                     'context (hasheq 'diagnostics '()))))
+  (check-not-equal? (hash-ref actions 'result) '())
+  (for ([action (in-list (hash-ref actions 'result))])
+    (check-equal? (hash-keys (hash-ref (hash-ref action 'edit) 'changes))
+                  (list (string->symbol uri))))
+  ;; The live file also uses `first`; imported virtual references must not merge it.
+  (define imported-references
+    (feature session 6 "textDocument/references" uri
+             (hasheq 'position (hasheq 'line 2 'character 25)
+                     'context (hasheq 'includeDeclaration #t))))
+  (check-equal? (length (hash-ref imported-references 'result)) 1)
+  (check-equal? (hash-ref (car (hash-ref imported-references 'result)) 'uri) uri)
+  ;; Imported definitions would need another disk-source analysis.
+  (check-equal? (hash-ref (feature session 5 "textDocument/definition" uri
+                                   (hasheq 'position (hasheq 'line 2 'character 25))) 'result)
+                (json-null)))

+    (define root (car (explode-path scratch)))

+            (define b (string-append virtual-prefix "?rev=two#cell"))
+            (for ([uri (in-list (list file-uri a b))]

+(module+ test

+    (source-controller-open! controller source reopened)
+    (check-equal? (Source-View-id previous)

+    (check-not-eq? (Source-View-revision previous)
+                   (Source-View-revision (source-controller-view controller source)))
+    (check-equal? (await (source-controller-ensure-analysis! controller old-snapshot))
+                  (Analysis-Outcome 'stopped 'ineligible))
+    (source-controller-handle! controller late-message)

+#lang racket/base
+
+;; Real stdio tests need strict framing: the production reader skips stray lines.
+(require json
+         racket/runtime-path)
+
+(provide read-frame call-with-server-process)
+
+(define-runtime-path main-path "../main.rkt")
+
+(define (read-frame in)
+  (define header (read-line in 'return-linefeed))
+  (cond
+    [(eof-object? header) eof]
+    [else
+     (define found (regexp-match #rx"^Content-Length: ([0-9]+)$" header))
+     (unless found (error 'read-frame "unexpected protocol header: ~s" header))
+     (unless (equal? (read-line in 'return-linefeed) "")
+       (error 'read-frame "missing header separator"))
+     (define size (string->number (cadr found)))
+     (define body (read-bytes size in))
+     (unless (and (bytes? body) (= (bytes-length body) size))
+       (error 'read-frame "incomplete protocol body"))
+     (bytes->jsexpr body)]))
+
+;; The callback owns normal shutdown and reader joins. Cleanup also handles a
+;; failed assertion; supplied stderr ports remain owned by the caller.
+(define (call-with-server-process proc
+                                  #:arguments [arguments '()]
+                                  #:environment [environment (current-environment-variables)]
+                                  #:stderr [error-port #f])
+  (define readers (make-custodian))
+  (define-values (server stdout stdin stderr)
+    (parameterize ([current-environment-variables environment])
+      (apply subprocess #f #f error-port (find-executable-path "racket")
+             (append arguments (list "-t" (path->string main-path))))))
+  (dynamic-wind
+    void
+    (lambda ()
+      (parameterize ([current-custodian readers])
+        (proc server stdout stdin stderr)))
+    (lambda ()
+      (subprocess-kill server #t)
+      (subprocess-wait server)
+      (custodian-shutdown-all readers)
+      (close-output-port stdin)
+      (close-input-port stdout)
+      (when stderr (close-input-port stderr)))))
